chapters.title: Chapter 2391 Divergence! II
paragraphs: Shadows!
This grand word was inscribed into an Apex Aeonic Relic that seemed to constantly release billowing smoke, the identity of these existences being clear as day!
At such a juncture, Roan finally rose from his throne as he looked grand and livid while staring towards Orion and Aurelia.
"I have led, Aurelia. I have led!"
BOOOM!

"Led our Lineage to even greater glory. On a path of survival! I need no lecture from you nor Genesis as I know full well the result of my choices and actions. Now...I believe we were voting. All those in favor of me continuing to act as the representative of all Lernaeans!"

Roan's hand shot up as soon after, the hands of the 13 newly appearing shadowy figures rose, those who sided with Roan coming out of their shock and sighing as they also raised their hands up in conjunction.

"I believe I have the majority of those present within this domain." His voice was magnetic and powerful as he spoke, the expressions of Orion, Aurelia, and Lucia among others turning entirely ugly as their bodies blazed gloriously with power!

Orion's expression was one of utter disbelief and rage as his sockets radiated Light that burned brighter than any sun, his words booming out along with his Dynamis of Extremity that was turning into milky white flames around him.
"You know full well the result of your choices?! If you knew, you wouldn't have made such a stupid one! You have invited outsiders into our very homes, into the very heart of our Lineage!"
WAA!
His voice was explosive as beside him Aurelia was blazing with a golden Dynamis of Extremity as her eyes were entirely filled with extreme disappointment and anger.
Yet even in the face of all this, Roan faced them coldly with the backing of immensely powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeforms whose auras seemed to match Aurelia's most powerful visage if not greater!

"They are outsiders no more. As the Representative of the Ancestral Lernaeans in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution has chosen to enter into an agreement with the Cult of Endless Shadows, we are one and the same. And the Lernaean Representative, I hold the authority of keeping Order within my Lineage by using the forces provided by the Cult of Endless Shadows."

Words that only caused the expressions on Orion and Aurelia to change more and more emanated out as an instant later, a leading man who seemed fairly young stepped out from the 13 newly appearing Shadows, his exceedingly handsome face becoming prevalent to all as he smiled and spoke out.

"That is right, Grand Primeval Roan. With your current distinction, this is within your power along with the boundless boons mentioned before. To the rest of the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms here, the positions of Primevals are free for you all to take within the Cult of Endless Shadows, along with multiple Consummate Boundaries and many more treasures to assist you in the Convergence of Dynamis of Extremity."
His voice carried a dazzling allure as his hair was a shadowy black and red, his pupils radiating endless darkness as he smiled while he continued.

"Of course, entering our folds is the decision you all can freely make as nobody will be forced. Nobody will come to harm...so long as the Order with the Ancestral Lernaean Lineage that is now one of the Lineages connected to the Cult of Endless is kept. If there are any who disrupt this order and go against the best interests of Lernaeans as deemed by Grand Primeval Roan...then I, Grand Primeval Silas, will personally make a move."
The threat was clearly laid out as only billowing Shadows rose to the skies!

The surroundings turned strangely silent as the heavy pressure of Wills was all that remained, the visage of Roan stepping forward again and looking at the heavy expressions of his Brethren as he spoke out calmly.

"You may think however you want of me. I made this move early to preserve my position, yes, but it is also for the best interest of all Lernaeans as we had to choose an Inheritance sooner or later. The Cult of Endless Shadows is a grand Inheritance whose boons surpassed all others as I ask you...my brothers and sisters of the same blood and creed- join me in this glory."
WAA!
The Deposed Emperor spread his arms out as he preached to his people, a terrifying development ensuing as the intersections of choices gave way to a terrifying result!

"Our domains will be centralized and moved from their far reaches into a single glowing cluster, with all Lernaeans enjoying the resources and protection of the Cult of Endless Shadows as the Noblesse, Quasarians, nor Planeswalkers can touch us. With this, the succession of our Lineage across the eons is preserved as it will be baptized under the flames of Extremity Sanctification and become etched in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!"

With the support of 13 terrifyingly formidable Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, Roan seemed invincible as even though Orion and Aurelia's figures trembled with rage and incredulity with every part of their bodies screaming to erupt and fight, their souls could sense the enemies before them vibrating with multiple Dynamis of Extremity within each of them!
The scene in the Lernaean Apex Aeonic Domain was quiet and yet utterly destructive as a vast Shadow covered a Lineage with a rich history.
Within the Infinite Plane.

The gazes of the Soul Clones of Orion and Aurelia who were meeting with the Dimensional Rulers instantly changed, but they weren't the only ones as the expression on the eyes of the Dream Dimensional Chassis also flickered sharply!

"Oh?" Yet Noah's eyes lit up when he heard this, his figure radiating Noah had the swirling light of Providence burn within his eyes as before the two Apex Aeonic Soul Clones even uttered anything, his voice emanated out.
"It seems like my plans have become that much harder to carry out...what has happened?"
His gaze turned towards Orion and Aurelia, the latter seeming much more fuming as she spat out with distaste.
"A damn fool has carried out the assimilation of the Lernaean Lineage into an Inheritance forcefully, dividing us internally as even waging a war will only cause deaths amongst ourselves!"
"Oh?" Yet Noah's eyes lit up when he heard this, his figure radiating a magnificent light as he gazed towards the stellar layers of Dimensions within his Infinite Plane while continuing.

"Another force is trying to get their hands on something I have my eyes on...then, it seems the time has come for me to absorb the Lernaean Sacrariums into my Infinite Plane. As for whatever inheritance is trying to stretch their fingers into something that is mine...they can only lay at my feet in the form of Loot!"
WAA!
The light of conquest and tyranny began to burn.
Even under the pressure of an Inheritance, Noah was unfazed as new plans formed in his mind at this very moment!

chapters.title: Chapter 2392 Merely An Inheritance! I
paragraphs: Eowyn, Guinevere, and a myriad of other Dimensional Rulers heard of the changes occurring within their Lineage as their souls blazed with battle intent.

Their Clones moved with Henry in the Domains of the Noblesse as under Noah's gifts, they had scaled the Boundary Expansion Realm rapidly as they could pose as genuine forces against their current enemies!
If they could contribute in any way...their hearts burned to do so.
These were their thoughts, but the thoughts of the maddened Apex Aeonic Soul Clone of Orion caught onto Noah's words and what they could truly mean as he asked carefully while calming his soul.
"You say that you can absorb the Lernaean Sacrariums into this Barren...no, Infinite Plane? Is it a mechanism of your unique power or?"

"No, it is a boon of the restructured Barren Lands that is now an Infinite Plane. Think of it as a Construct and not like any Plane of Existence or domain- and this construct can devour any Sacrariums that are based within Planes of Existence."
Noah replied to Orion simply even though his words were of great shock to him!
The same applied to Aurelia as the rage in her golden eyes was pushed aside briefly while she focused on Noah.
"A construct? Is your Forge not your greatest accomplishment? Exactly what did you do to the past Barren Lands?"
What did Noah do?

He wouldn't tell them that he entirely assimilated and bound the Source of Reality into a construct that began as a mere floating landmass, a spiritual land in an insignificant world! He wouldn't tell them that the current Dimensions they saw were entirely consumed and reformed by him.
He only smiled grandly as he replied while moving his gaze from Aurelia to Orion.

"Whatever I may have done, I can affirm that within a matter of seconds- I can displace an entire Plane of Existence into the Infinite Plane. Its Source will either be utilized to enlarge the currently existing Planes in here or structured into another Plane entirely. As for the existences within a targeted Plane...they can also be brought into the Infinite Plane so long as they offer up an insignificant portion of their soul to be bound to me!"
WAA!
The sockets of Orion and the eyes of Aurelia sparkled with profound thought as Aurelia was the first one to reply.
"You mean for them to bend the knee?"

Noah smiled devilishly as he replied. "In a way. After all, I have to have assurances before bringing just anyone into this Infinite Plane. Nobody is restricted in any way as the only things I impose are rules to follow to keep this wondrous construct concealed from others and the stoppage of conflicts against each other."
This was what existences who sworn Fealty to Noah went through!I think you should take a look at
And now as time came to greatly enlarge his Vassals, Noah could feel the essence of Conquest being roused as this Boundary pulsed with fervor.
And as his words settled in, the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms before him truly seemed to understand just what they meant as Orion shook his head with great anger and sorrow.

"With such a tool like this available, we could have quietly assimilated all of the Lernaean Domains into this hidden Plane while adapting to understand the Consummate Boundaries here. With enough time and resources that will only increase in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution as Extremity Sanctification is underway...we could have raised frightening Unequaled Reverend Emperors and Apex Aeonic Lifeforms without being under the scrutiny of others, where the dream of becoming an Inheritance ourselves...would truly not be an impossibility!"
His words were filled with regret and possibilities as it was too late!
All of this could've happened in the past as...
"If only Roan had not...ah!"
Orion couldn't even bring himself to say much else as to this, Noah's visage moved forward while he spoke out.

"I will begin moving to swallow as many Lernaean Domains as possible. The Apex Aeonic Lifeforms siding with this foolish Roan or from the Cult of Endless Shadows can't do anything to me, and any Reverends they send...will only become energy for me!"
A commanding light erupted from him as Orion came to focus on his figure closely.
The First True Emperor was briefly silent before he asked.

"I know not of the True extent of your power as a Reverend, but can you match even the strongest Unequaled Reverend Emperors from an Inheritance? They have Extremity Circulation Modus Operandis as their tools, and with them, they can harmonize and circulate the essence of their strongest Boundaries through every single cell to achieve an effect similar to a Dynamis of Extremity even before they have become Apex Aeonic Lifeforms. Some of them are even Mutated Entities as their power isn't something captured within the bounds of common sense. Under the excuse of keeping Order within the Lernaean Lineage, the Grand Primeval Silas of the Cult of Endless Shadows will send droves of such beings to stop you the moment that word spreads."
Extremity Circulation Modus Operandi!

Methodologies on the circulation of multiple Boundary Essences to achieve shocking effects as they were also one of the tools powerful Inheritances held which brought being ever closer to forming Dynamis of Extremity.

Noah recalled the unique layering and cluster of Essences on the body of Phos from the Extremity of Light that had collided with his Unknown Dynamis of Extremity unscathed as a light of profundity shone within his eyes.
From the memories of Titus and others, he knew about such Methodologies even though any true thought about them seemed to be burned away within their souls as he couldn't attain anything.

Titus and the others he had destroyed so far stemming from Inheritances also didn't seem to practice it as those who did seemed to be the cream of the crop! And truly, only within an Aeonic Inheritance of Extremity would such profound methods exist where they may even be capable of disseminating it to all of their Scions.
But even against all of this, Noah was fearless!

Some of them are even Mutated Entities as their power isn't something captured within the bounds of common sense.
Under the excuse of keeping Order within the Lernaean Lineage, the Grand Primeval Silas of the Cult of Endless Shadows will send droves of such beings to stop you the moment that word spreads."
Extremity Circulation Modus Operandi!

Methodologies on the circulation of multiple Boundary Essences to achieve shocking effects as they were also one of the tools powerful Inheritances held which brought being ever closer to forming Dynamis of Extremity.

Noah recalled the unique layering and cluster of Essences on the body of Phos from the Extremity of Light that had collided with his Unknown Dynamis of Extremity unscathed as a light of profundity shone within his eyes.
From the memories of Titus and others, he knew about such Methodologies even though any true thought about them seemed to be burned away within their souls as he couldn't attain anything.
Titus and the others he had destroyed so far stemming from Inheritances also didn't seem to practice it as those who did seemed to be the cream of the crop!
And truly, only within an Aeonic Inheritance of Extremity would such profound methods exist where they may even be capable of disseminating it to all of their Scions.
But even against all of this, Noah was fearless!

chapters.title: Chapter 2393 Merely An Inheritance! II
paragraphs: In the face of the immense power an Inheritance held and the countless tools at their fingertips, Noah was unfettered as he looked straight at Orion and replied to his worries.

"So what if they have Extremity Circulation methodologies, Mutated Lifeforms, or even Apex Aeonic Soul Totems? They are merely forces from an Inheritance- one that hasn't even become an Aeonic Inheritance of Extremity! Whatever they send will not be worth much in my eyes as they won't stop my advancement."
WAA!
Glorious words filled with power and confidence emanated out as those who heard them could only take them in silently.
Orion looked at Noah with an utterly serious gaze as he seemed to have made up his mind, speaking out a moment later.

"Then I shall trust in your words no matter how unreal they sound. After all, you were able to accomplish wonders with the past Barren Lands. Instead of jumping straight into waging a war with an Inheritance, let me aid you. Before Roan can disseminate his new authority and before the Cult of Endless Shadows entrenches themselves into the Lernaean Lineage, we can have you take in as many Sacrariums as possible before they even catch on."
His gaze was firm as the milky white light within his eyes shone with ever greater majesty!

"I can immediately teleport you to all the Sacrariums stretched out across the Havens of Dissolution, you can take them into this Infinite Plane with whatever methods you have, and I will release my authority as Genesis to command the Lernaeans within to give up a portion of their souls to you in order for them to be allowed entry into this Plane as well. Maximilian can manage relocation and everything else thereafter..."

The True Emperor of Genesis thought about his own power and what he could do before things became drastically worse, and the path he chose was to take as much of the Lernaean Lineage away before Roan nor the Cult of Endless Shadows even noticed!
It was a path that in Noah's perspective...he was being delivered grand benefits by an Apex Aeonic Lifeform himself.

Who could've expected his Conquest of the Lernaean Lineage to flow this way? That one of its strongest beings when pressured on all sides by foreign enemies would deliver Noah to the Sacrariums himself and even use his authority to have the countless Lernaean swear loyalty to him?!
And yet when Noah came to this thought...the Dream Dimensional Chassis shone with a golden light of brilliance while at the same time, 8 other vibrant lights began to manifest around it.

"There isn't even a need for you to use your authority to convince them of anything. Due to the limitations of time where we have to do this as quickly as we can, I can overpower it and obtain the Fealty of any average beings at the 9th Boundary Layer of achievements or below with a release of my will. No harm will come to their souls and I can move all of them an instant after..."
A devilish glow shone in his eyes as he spoke of a grand ability while around him, other Chassis began to manifest.I think you should take a look at
An ability that came from nothing else but the 9th Boundary Layer of Conquest!

[The Ninth Boundary Layer of Conquest]:: You have reached a stage of Conquest that allows for your Aeonic Soul to gain the capability of Aeonic Dominator's Haki. It is the release of your Tyrannical soul power and the essence of Conquest to allow for the widespread Conquest of any beings that fall under the area of effect of your released will. The Haki is uniquely concentrated as it will impose a heavy pressure and burden on any Soul that resists the initial outburst. Those with less Aeonic Soul Values than you will have a 99% certainty of Conquest, with those at similar levels of Aeonic Soul Values having this certainty reduced to 25%, and those stronger than you being able to resist your will as there is less than a 1% chance to Conquer their souls. The spread of the Aeonic Dominator's Haki requires 1% of your Aeonic Soul Values to release. The more Aeonic Souls you Conquer, the greater quantity and quality of the Aeonic Light Conquest you will accumulate. With a sufficient concentration of the Aeonic Light of Conquest, the elevation of Boundaries across the Consummate stage is possible...
Yes!
A pure soul attack that allowed him to release Aeonic Dominator's Haki and immediately subdue those weaker than him to forcefully make them his Vassals!

If Orion was going to take him to different Sacrariums for them to be quickly devoured and assimilated by him along with the countless Lernaeans within it, this terrifying ability to immediately Conquer the souls of those weaker would make the process even faster.
BZZZT!

As he was speaking the 8 dazzling lights around him fully manifested as the other Dimensional Chassis who were remaining in the Source of Reality cultivating to accumulate Quintessential Experience Points of Extremity stopped their tasks as they stepped out, each of them beginning to pulse the light of a certain feature of the Infinite Plane.
It was the feature of Pocket Infinite Plane that allowed for a miniaturized cluster of authority that represented the Infinite Plane itself!
It was this that Noah could utilize for the process of assimilation and assimilation of planes!
And as he summoned them out, the voice of Aurelia rang out sharply as Orion seemed to still be thinking of his words.
"You have 9 bodies that correspond to the 9 Dimensions of the past Barren Lands? Is that how you turned it into a construct? Did you merge your will with the very Planes?"
Her eyes released profound light as she tried to pry for Noah's methodology, his Dimensional clones only smiling towards her as the visage of Orion nodded with affirmation at this time.

"It matters not what his means were. Okay, we can do it as you propose. Let us make haste and start with the Abecedarian Sacrarium. And if all the bodies you've called here have the same capabilities to displace Planes, this will make it even faster..."
WAA!
A milky white light of a Dynamis shone as an unprecedented covert mission bloomed!

chapters.title: Chapter 2394 Merely An Inheritance! III
paragraphs: The means of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms were unfathomable to lower Lifeforms.

The actions of Orion sought to display such a statement fully as the milky white light twisted space and time while commandingly pulling it forward- bending it to its will as within the next few nanoseconds, one portal after another began to form.
His expression didn't seem the least bit fazed as he spoke out after 9 milky white portals formed.

"Each one will lead you above a Sacrarium Domain where you can begin your displacements. I will attack my will with them and sense any changes that occur around each one. When you're done, simply enter through the same portal again as I will have it set to directly link to a different Sacrarium."
An ecstatic method bloomed as Orion seemed to react to Noah's methods, where the moment multiple clones were unveiled- so was this new move by Orion!

At the same time, Aurelia's body blazed with a golden light as a Dynamis of Extremity erupted to smoothly mix in with the milky white, a dense aura of Extremity radiating from this region as her sonorous voice rang out.

"I'll also actively mask you and the movements you make in the regions these portals lead to ensure that you aren't found out too quickly. With this, we can reclaim the vast majority of Lernaean Domains without already falling into war. When they find you, they cannot attack you, but they will know where to flaunt their might as we will be the next targets. So hurry."
WAA!

Two Apex Aeonic Lifeforms provided the support they could as Noah's Dimensional Chassis from 9 different Dimensional Realities moved forward calmly, each one delving into one of the dazzling milky gold white portals ad they carried the authority of the Infinite Plane in a miniaturized Pocket Dimensional Reality!
Above the Abecedarian Sacrarium.

Maximilian had received word from Orion about the recent developments and what they planned to do in this relatively short period of time, his heart fluttering at this newfound situation that was rolling out at an extremely fast pace as when he raised his head, he could see a golden white light cracking open the space above the massive Plane of Existence they were in- this golden white color spreading out many light years as at its center...a man adorned in gold stepped out.
It was the Dream Dimensional Chassis of the True Emperor of Quintessence.
Maximilian recalled Orion's words as he saw this being buzz with wild power in the next instant.

'His Soul will sweep to dominate and take a portion of the souls of the Lernaeans he saves in order for them to be taken into the old Barren Lands. You will be needed to keep order and relocate all those that arrive now and later, so be among the first to release a portion of your soul to him. For the sake of all Lernaeans."
Orion didn't ask him to pledge fealty by using his authority and commanding it so.
He reminded him that he was doing all this for none other than the countless masses of beings he bore the weight of!
So in the next second as a maddening soul storm surged out in the form of Haki from the True Emperor of Quintessence, Maximilian was among the first to leave his soul free of any influence.
For the sake of Lernaeans, he would do anything- even if it was giving his soul up to a Demon with unknown means!
Above the Abecedarian Sacrarium.I think you should take a look at
Noah's soul vibrated madly as he spoke out.
[Aeonic Dominator's Haki]

An insignificant portion of his Aeonic Soul Values were used up as Aeonic Mana of Extremity filled in the rest, a point of constant usage also forming as Noah commanded his Haki to expand and cover all of the Plane before him!
A multicolored wave of pressure released with him at the very center.
How had his power changed over the weeks and months?
He had no need to converse or send messages for others to pledge fealty at this moment in time.
He would simply release his Haki as all those falling within its range would automatically fall under his banner of conquest!
From young to old.
From those who had just expanded their first concept towards Extremity to those who had expanded this concept into the 9th Boundary Layer!
Every single area within the Abecedarian Sacrarium that his Aeonic Dominator's Haki passed, the minds of Lernaeans shook as they were immediately conquered with a pledge of Fealty being made!

From the Elder Ancestors positioned beside Maximilian, and all the way to the ramparts and fortresses enacted in the periphery of the Abecedarian Sacrarium where existences coming in from the Planar Palisades of Extremity had to cross.

All the way to the figure of a newly arriving Charlemagne and a few other Ancestral Descendants who had left the Barren Lands two days ago as one of the two parties from the Quantum Dimension and were just now arriving with nearly all of their party wiped out from traversing the terrors of the Planar Palisades of Extremity alone...even these beings were blanketed by the waves of Haki as they were incredulously forced to oath Fealty!

Noah gazed at the vast light years his soul reached across as he saw dazzling lights of conquest surging upwards towards his own Soul, his visage decisive as he spoke out while releasing the authority of the Pocket Infinite Plane towards the region below him.
"Devour and assimilate."
BZZZT!
For the first time in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, the light of a gourmandizing construct flashed in the Havens of Extremity to devour a Plane of Existence!

Within the Plane itself, beings like the True Emperor of Light who had achieved the status of a Reverend and weren't prepared for the wave of Haki that descended were only able to resist for a moment before their Wills were overcome and a oath of Fealty was made.
Ophelia and other beings already made Vassals watched on with shining eyes as they were among the few who managed to observe what happened next.

They managed to witness what prodigious and terrifying stage of might the Infinite Plane had reached as the entire process to consume the colossal Plane that was the Abecedarian Sacrarium...took a grand total of two seconds!

chapters.title: Chapter 2395 Merely An Inheritance! IV
paragraphs: Maximilian's Soul Clone had accepted the descending haki and pledged Fealty quicker than all other Lernaeans, and he was among those who were able to regain their faculties and witness just what happened next.

The best way he could describe it...was that an unimaginably dense singularity of Infinite mass and energy erupted out and devoured everything- the very structure of the fabric of Reality around them and their bodies included!
They then faced an immense darkness as a second later, his Will was able to discern golden brilliance.
He felt the golden sands around him shift as he knew he was no longer in the Havens of Extremity.
When he gazed up, he saw radiant and massive sandy gold Cosmos spinning in an endless stellar expanse, where even further up, the purple light of...
"Avalon?"

His eyes trembled as he was barely able to recognize that he was on the sandy gold floor of the genuine Dream Dimension that stretched out endlessly, and far, far above them was the exterior of the Avalon Dimension that could barely be seen!
In his amazement, he also observed how around him, quintillions upon quintillions of Lernaeans began to appear across the expanse of sandy golden dunes as they looked around in incredulity and shock.
When he saw this, he immediately came out of his stupor.
This was his task.
To manage the countless Lernaeans that were about to arrive here as it didn't matter how any of this was possible!
"O my people!"
A milky white gold portal lay behind him.

And before his eyes, it seemed like a massive chunk of space was missing as if it had been entirely eaten, the whole Abecedarian Sacrarium nowhere to be seen as Noah only gazed down coldly while his soul felt ever greater waves of power!

The essence of the Plane of Existence was devoured as it would be added to the ever expanding Planes within the Infinite Plane, and the countless Lernaeans were deposited into the Dream Dimensional Reality for their future integration into these lands where they would choose where to live.

His Dream Dimensional Chassis did such a dreadful thing as after ascertaining no signs of life in the surroundings, he entered the milky white gold portal behind him as he was shuttled across the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution and towards another location that held a Sacrarium of the Ancestral Lernaeans!

At the same time he did this, 8 other Dimensional Chassis also turned away from points in space that looked like empty holes carved out of their reality- 8 other Planes of Existence being devoured within a matter of seconds along with countless Lernaeans.
Quintillions upon quintillions instantly pledging fealty to him.
It caused the light of Conquest to burn brightly as his Aeonic Soul Values continued their exponential ascent!

Just like this, Noah began to devour the domains of one of the four prominent Lineages of the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution silently and with haste- the Inheritance that had just spread their influence on this Lineage being none the wiser!
Within the hidden folds of space where the Lernaean Apex Aeonic Domain resided.
A vast Shadow seemed to cover everything as it extended from The Deposed Emperor- from the Grand Primeval Roan of the Cult of Endless Shadows and seemed to stretch out Infinitely!
Roan watched the wrathful gazes of Orion and Aurelia as he knew they wouldn't take things lying down, and he already had plans for this as-
"Okay."
His pupils constricted as he heard a single word from Orion as he seemed to be containing his rage.I think you should take a look at

"When the other Lernaean Apex Aeonic Lifeforms return, let them know of the grand choices you made on behalf of all of us. When the very identity of Lernaeans is washed away in the river of history...only then will you truly understand what you have done. When you have no legacy nor friends to accompany you, I hope the power you've achieved will be sufficient to console your soul then."
WAA!
His words felt sharper and more dreadful than any attacks he could have thrown!
Roan still thought correct. Orion didn't take it lying down as he did attack, but he attacked in the worst way possible even his steeled soup vibrated at his words that continued.

"I will not participate in what is to come, so I can only wish that you truly bear the weight of your choice and see what future will unfold for Lernaeans. For any of those opposed to Roan's choice, you can follow me."
A deep voice full of contained anger and wisdom.
This was what emanated out as soon after, three blazing lights of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms left their positions to come float beside Orion, Aurelia, and Lucia.

Others remained where they were with difficult expressions as since things had come to this...why not follow the flow of Destiny and attain the boons of an Inheritance of their Lineage that had already fallen under them? Yet they still felt shameful of their choices as their heads turned down to not even gaze towards Genesis and the others.

Maximilian's main body had a profound expression in his eyes as he also appeared behind them, immense loss present on his face as when Roan looked at all of them, even more anger rose from the depths of his soul!

"Foolishness. Where will you go that will provide you with a path towards Extremity if not an Inheritance? You will have to give up even more if you try joining an Aeonic Inheritance of Extremity once you leave here. If things have come to this, why not just accept them as they are? Keep our forces together. Just adapt to the situation and join the Cult of Endless Shadows."
Even in his anger, he still brought himself to say such a thing as he wanted all of them to rise together!
Yet...Orion's gaze was cold as a milky portal appeared behind him.
"You've made your choice, we shall make ours."
A radiant milky white brilliance bloomed as one after another, Orion and those who followed him went into it.
A heavy silence descended on the surroundings soon after as it was only broken by laughter from Grand Primeval Silas!
"Hah, that was truly surprising. I never would have thought that many would choose to leave when such great boons are before them. This is perplexing..."
His potent gaze and visage that was wrapped by multiple Dynamis of Extremity emanated immense magnificence as Roan snorted while replying in distaste.
"It is only because they believe they can make something of themselves because from our Descendants, one who holds a few Consummate Boundaries rose."
His words immediately caused the brows of Grand Primeval Silas to rise.
"What?"
"Yes, an unruly Descendant who wants to be enthroned to lead Lernaeans in exchange for his Consummate Bou-"
BZZT!
Before Roan's words even finished, a glorious power erupted from Grand Primeval Silas as he harrumphed while interrupting.

"Why didn't you say so earlier? If there's someone like that, we can not have them taking him away. Since all Lernaeans are under the banner of the Cult of Endless Shadows, so is he. And any Boundaries held by our people...are also our property. Let's go. No matter how unruly, I will show you how to deal with a Scion that won't cooperate."

He felt the golden sands around him shift as he knew he was no longer in the Havens of Extremity.
When he gazed up, he saw radiant and massive sandy gold Cosmos spinning in an endless stellar expanse, where even further up, the purple light of...
"Avalon?"

His eyes trembled as he was barely able to recognize that he was on the sandy gold floor of the genuine Dream Dimension that stretched out endlessly, and far, far above them was the exterior of the Avalon Dimension that could barely be seen!
In his amazement, he also observed how around him, quintillions upon quintillions of Lernaeans began to appear across the expanse of sandy golden dunes as they looked around in incredulity and shock.
When he saw this, he immediately came out of his stupor.
This was his task.
To manage the countless Lernaeans that were about to arrive here as it didn't matter how any of this was possible!
"O my people!"
A milky white gold portal lay behind him.

And before his eyes, it seemed like a massive chunk of space was missing as if it had been entirely eaten, the whole Abecedarian Sacrarium nowhere to be seen as Noah only gazed down coldly while his soul felt ever greater waves of power!

The essence of the Plane of Existence was devoured as it would be added to the ever expanding Planes within the Infinite Plane, and the countless Lernaeans were deposited into the Dream Dimensional Reality for their future integration into these lands where they would choose where to live.

His Dream Dimensional Chassis did such a dreadful thing as after ascertaining no signs of life in the surroundings, he entered the milky white gold portal behind him as he was shuttled across the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution and towards another location that held a Sacrarium of the Ancestral Lernaeans!

At the same time he did this, 8 other Dimensional Chassis also turned away from points in space that looked like empty holes carved out of their reality- 8 other Planes of Existence being devoured within a matter of seconds along with countless Lernaeans.
Quintillions upon quintillions instantly pledging fealty to him.
It caused the light of Conquest to burn brightly as his Aeonic Soul Values continued their exponential ascent!

Just like this, Noah began to devour the domains of one of the four prominent Lineages of the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution silently and with haste- the Inheritance that had just spread their influence on this Lineage being none the wiser!
Within the hidden folds of space where the Lernaean Apex Aeonic Domain resided.
A vast Shadow seemed to cover everything as it extended from The Deposed Emperor- from the Grand Primeval Roan of the Cult of Endless Shadows and seemed to stretch out Infinitely!
Roan watched the wrathful gazes of Orion and Aurelia as he knew they wouldn't take things lying down, and he already had plans for this as-
"Okay."
His pupils constricted as he heard a single word from Orion as he seemed to be containing his rage.I think you should take a look at
"When the other Lernaean Apex Aeonic Lifeforms return, let them know of the grand choices you made on behalf of all of us.
When the very identity of Lernaeans is washed away in the river of history...only then will you truly understand what you have done.
When you have no legacy nor friends to accompany you, I hope the power you've achieved will be sufficient to console your soul then."
WAA!
His words felt sharper and more dreadful than any attacks he could have thrown!
Roan still thought correct.
Orion didn't take it lying down as he did attack, but he attacked in the worst way possible even his steeled soup vibrated at his words that continued.
"I will not participate in what is to come, so I can only wish that you truly bear the weight of your choice and see what future will unfold for Lernaeans.
For any of those opposed to Roan's choice, you can follow me."
A deep voice full of contained anger and wisdom.
This was what emanated out as soon after, three blazing lights of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms left their positions to come float beside Orion, Aurelia, and Lucia.

Others remained where they were with difficult expressions as since things had come to this...why not follow the flow of Destiny and attain the boons of an Inheritance of their Lineage that had already fallen under them?
Yet they still felt shameful of their choices as their heads turned down to not even gaze towards Genesis and the others.

Maximilian's main body had a profound expression in his eyes as he also appeared behind them, immense loss present on his face as when Roan looked at all of them, even more anger rose from the depths of his soul!
"Foolishness.
Where will you go that will provide you with a path towards Extremity if not an Inheritance?
You will have to give up even more if you try joining an Aeonic Inheritance of Extremity once you leave here.
If things have come to this, why not just accept them as they are?
Keep our forces together.
Just adapt to the situation and join the Cult of Endless Shadows."
Even in his anger, he still brought himself to say such a thing as he wanted all of them to rise together!
Yet...Orion's gaze was cold as a milky portal appeared behind him.
"You've made your choice, we shall make ours."
A radiant milky white brilliance bloomed as one after another, Orion and those who followed him went into it.
A heavy silence descended on the surroundings soon after as it was only broken by laughter from Grand Primeval Silas!
"Hah, that was truly surprising.
I never would have thought that many would choose to leave when such great boons are before them.
This is perplexing..."
His potent gaze and visage that was wrapped by multiple Dynamis of Extremity emanated immense magnificence as Roan snorted while replying in distaste.
"It is only because they believe they can make something of themselves because from our Descendants, one who holds a few Consummate Boundaries rose."
His words immediately caused the brows of Grand Primeval Silas to rise.
"What?"
"Yes, an unruly Descendant who wants to be enthroned to lead Lernaeans in exchange for his Consummate Bou-"
BZZT!
Before Roan's words even finished, a glorious power erupted from Grand Primeval Silas as he harrumphed while interrupting.
"Why didn't you say so earlier?
If there's someone like that, we can not have them taking him away.
Since all Lernaeans are under the banner of the Cult of Endless Shadows, so is he.
And any Boundaries held by our people...are also our property.
Let's go.
No matter how unruly, I will show you how to deal with a Scion that won't cooperate."

chapters.title: Chapter 2396 Merely An Inheritance! V
paragraphs: "You would concern this much for the Consummate Boundaries stemming from a single being? I would have thought the Cult of Endless Shadows held more than enough in their hands - of even greater quality too."
Roan spoke towards the visage of Grand Primeval Silas who was forming a massive spatial vortex in front of them.
The eyes of this being from the Cult of Endless Shadows were full of calm and power as he replied.

"As you get more familiar with the Convergence of Boundaries to form Dynamis of Extremity, you will come to understand the importance of Consummate Boundaries. They are akin to the most pristine ingredients to form a Dynamis of Extremity as one can most easily and successfully achieve Convergence with the highest chance from such a level of Boundaries. It is nearly an impossibility to form Dynamis of Extremity with Innate or Planar Boundaries entirely. But apart from this...they also have to fit together akin to a piece of a puzzle."

"The biggest issue that stands in the way of Boundaries converging to become Dynamis of Extremity is not just how arduous it is to fuse even two Consummate concepts together, but the fact that finding two that harmonize and match is immensely difficult. So the more Consummate Boundaries you collect, the better. You might come to find that the Consummate Boundaries of this being you're considering as nothing may just be the key to solving a puzzle that will birth a Dynamis of Extremity across any of us here...so, what are the coordinates where this Lernaean is at?"

His composure was overwhelming as he asked, Roan's eyes shining sharply as he waved his hands to infuse the coordinates of the Abecedarian Sacrarium into the massive spatial vortex that Grand Primeval Silas had been forming.

"Zaka, Nigel, Christopher...stand by and take stock of all the domains of Lernaeans that now fall under the Cult of Endless Shadows. Check them to see if any Mutated Entities are hidden within for us to discover, and begin the process of Domains Centralization."
Grand Primeval Silas gazed towards a few other members of the Cult of Endless Shadows as he spoke of profound concepts!
One was the discovery of any Mutated Souls within the Ancestral Lernaeans as the other...was Domain Centralization.
A concept that was most commonly understood in other Havens where multiple Inheritances reigned across different regions.
It was the action of forcibly moving the scattered Domains of a certain lineage or faction across a Haven and bringing them together into one massive cluster!

It meant utilizing the power of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms to stably wrap around Planes of Existence or whatever environment their existences were living in and transporting it for countless light years into a predetermined location.
It was to contain all of their forces in one area where they could patrol and defend, and they would expand their domain outwardly from there over the years that passed!
Roan's heart was heavy as he saw this whole procession start, his gaze coming to land on the Lernaean Apex Aeonic Lifeforms that stood by him as he also voiced out.
"Aid them in any way you can."

He would have to familiarize himself with it soon, but there was about to be no distinction between Lernaean Apex Aeonic Lifeforms or those from the Cult of Endless Shadows as they would soon be one and the same!

"Oh, silly me, before I forget..." And at such a juncture...Grand Primeval Silas beckoned behind him as his massive shadow that stretched out endlessly spat out dazzling crystalloids to float above his hand, their grandeur shining brightly as they were Aeonic Runestones possessing an unknown number of things within them.
They floated towards Roan and other Lernaean Apex Aeonic Lifeforms as Grand Primeval Silas smiled brilliantly.I think you should take a look at

"Runestones containing Consummate Boundary Essence Crystals for you all to get started on our Consummate Boundary of Shadows and more, along with Apex Aeonic Relics and many more surprises within. Let me officially welcome you all to the Cult of Endless Shadows!"
WAA!

His demeanor was full of grandeur as Roan accepted a second Runestone while others obtained their first, their gazes finally settling after getting their hands on boons as they would be all that much more agreeable in what was to come!

Grand Primeval Silas smiled at this as his visage floated into the massive vortex he had conjured up, Roan following behind him along with 7 more Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from the Cult of Endless Shadows.
"Let's go see this unruly Descendant possessing Consummate Boundaries. If that Orion is interfering and trying to take him, then you know what I must do, right?"
Their figures shuttled across an unknown number of light years as the voice of Silas emanated out.
"It would be interfering with the order of a new faction that is now a part of the Cult of Endless Shadows. Akin to him stealing from us."
Roan's eyes were sharp as he replied coldly.

"You promised me no deaths for any of the Lernaean Apex Aeonic Lifeforms in all this. Just incapacitate him and those following him. They will turn to us soon enough when this avenue is closed as well."
A chilling light passed through the eyes of Grand Primeval Silas as he heard this, his smile becoming ever brighter as the end of the spatial vortex appeared while their figures stepped out.
"Of course..."
SHAA!
The scene before then changed as a rift opened in space to reveal their overwhelming figures.
9 powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeforms in total- Grand Primeval Silas and Roan along with 7 from the Cult of Endless Shadows!
They appeared above the Abecedarian Sacrarium as...
"What is this? These are the coordinates to the Domain where the unruly Descendant is in?"

Silas' gaze changed as he saw a smoothly carved out depression on a stellar earth that extended for many light years below him- his will surging out and seeing no signs of smart Lifeforms in this area below him!

chapters.title: Chapter 2397 Merely An Inheritance! VI
paragraphs: "It is the Abecedarian Sacrarium..." Roan voiced out in shock at the absence of the massive Plane of Existence that was here as his gaze changed, feeling a dangerous aura erupt from Silas at this situation!

It was truly perplexing as even if Orion and the others were involved in forcibly moving the Sacrarium away from here, it was a process that took time as they had to stabilize the stellar bodies within the Planes with their very own souls and move them slowly- otherwise the stellar bodies and Lifeforms within could undergo great destruction from the sudden and rapid movements of their Plane of Existence.

It was akin to plucking a world that was stably moving in space with one's hands as if the existences within it weren't stabilized and anchored in a unique way, everyone within such a world would be crushed by the sudden changes in gravitational forces and movement!
"This is a declaration of war against us. You all, start spreading out and wait for my word. Engage the moment you see them."
As he spoke, Silas' body released magnificently dense smoke that covered the vast region above the concave depression.
"Let's see where you went..."

A Singularity of darkness bloomed and expanded to form a thin sheet of darkness that stood over the area where the Abecedarian Sacrarium used to be, and then an instant later...this thin film of darkness reflected the scene of the concave depression on the stellar earth below as spacetime continuum began to twist and churn!
"Everything has a shadow. History lays behind the greatest shadows as we can easily peek to see the shadows of history here..."

Silas' voice was grand and majestic as he spoke, the illusory scene reflected in the shadows showing a reversal of time at a very rapid pace as within moments...they saw the eruption of an illusory shadowy Plane of Existence!
This scene surprised the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms as they expects to see a reversal of time that showed the direction that the Plane was taken to, but it seemed like it disappeared right here.
Silas' eyes became sharper as he slowed the reversed scene down.

A few seconds before the disappearance of the Plane, his perceptive eyes captured the blooming of a milky white portal as well as the visage of a being stepping out of it who brought his hand down to barely touch the bounds of the Plane below him as seconds after that...
WAP!
The Plane entirely disappeared.
Silence reigned as the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms watched this scene.

The figure coming out of the portal was veiled as Silas had to erupt with waves of dense obsidian light before the veil covering him became clear, Roan looking at the figure shown on the illusory scene in shock as he recognized it from the intelligence reports sent out through the Automaton Boundary Modulators!
"That is...the unruly Descendant who wants to be enthroned. How did he...?"

"Oh? This is more serious than we thought if this Descendant has such capabilities. If he did this for the domain here, he may be doing it for other domains as well...quickly, share the coordinates of all other Lernaean Domains nearby!"
WAA!

The minds of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms worked fast as those Roan had sent out to look for traces were recalled, Roan sending out a dense cluster of information that contained all the coordinates of Lernaean Domains as he spoke out.
"Even if you locate him, you cannot do anything against him. How do you plan to-"

"You let me worry about that and find his current location first. I have dozens of groups of Shadowlings meant to enter the Extremity Vein of Dissolution that I've sent a message to be redirected. Find his current location first and simply lock down the space. We can do that much without the Extremity Adjudicator admonishing us!"
The power of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms buzzed as they used their terrifying prestige to locate a single being!
[Aeonic Dominator's Haki]
BOOM!
His Will raged down with glory as quintillions upon quintillions of souls were conquered in the blink of an eye.

His hand then extended down the authority of the Pocket Infinite Plane a fiery crimson Major Planes of Existence below him that floated in a region of lava-filled mountains began to twist and distort, everything about it devoured within the next few seconds as Noah turned back to enter to milky gold portal once more!I think you should take a look at
He had already done this process 8 times just with the Dream Dimensional Chassis alone as the other 8 Clones were making just as much progress.
His figure was shuttled across spacetime under the control of the spatial vortices that continued to be created by Genesis and supported by Aurelia as very quickly, he appeared in another region.
Tendrils of Nullity could be seen arcing in the distance as below him, a cluster of Minor Planes of Existence could be seen- this being a major Domain of the Lernaeans known as the Argeus Cluster!
His Haki reverberated out once more as he began the procedure all over again, and just as he was devouring the last Minor Plane here...
HOONG!
His soul buzzed.

His gaze turned towards the far away space as an instant later, a terrifying aura ripped across spacetime and teleported in as it was an existence whose shadow stretched out endlessly behind him, his face covered with a dark veil as the moment he appeared- a stupendous dominance emerged from him the moment he noticed Noah's figure!

Massive chains of darkness pulsing with a Dynamis of Extremity emerged and covered everything in an instant, space becoming utterly locked as moving across it or teleporting in or out would mean denying the dominance of a Dynamis of Extremity that was just set down!
And the one to do that had to have just as much power if not more.

The vibrant milky white gold portal behind Noah still pulsed and resisted as he could've abandoned the remaining Minor Plane and escaped, but he didn't even make a move to do so as he calmly finished fully devouring the last Plane half a second later, where at this time...dazzling obsidian shackles wrapped around the white gold portal as it could be accessed no longer!
An enemy Apex Aeonic Lifeform appeared before him, and yet the True Emperor of Quintessence didn't choose to run.
If they found him this fast, it meant that they had discovered something and were randomly looking across the Lernaean Domains to track him down.
Since they had found him, he wouldn't give them another chance to keep on looking and find the other 8 Clones moving in different regions that continued to devour more and more Sacrariums!
'Focus on me...' His eyes released a grand golden light as just like he expected...
BZZT!
Besides the Apex Aeonic Lifeform that appeared first, multiple more came in one after another until 9 dazzling auras caused the surrounding space to creak and tremble.
One aura exceedingly stronger than the rest appeared at the forefront as Noah recognized the figure of Lineage Emperor Roan beside him from the many memories he had obtained from Lernaeans!
His eyes became sharp as a devilish smile bloomed on his face.
Even though he stared at frightening Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, he spoke out freely.
"Well, isn't this a special day. To have the Lernaean Lineage Emperor Roan himself and multiple other Apex Aeonic Lifeforms lock down space just for me..."

The pressure of the entities before him increased a hundredfold as none of it was localized on him, the covering on the strongest aura here lifted as a handsome man surrounded by darkness unveiled himself with a calm smile as well.
"The unruly Descendant that holds Consummate Boundaries...do I really not see even an ounce of fear as you stand before esteemed Lifeforms from the Cult of Endless Shadows?"
His demeanor was just as overbearing as he didn't even leave room for Roan to impose himself. Hair as black as night and eyes that seemed like singularities of darkness.
A dazzling rune of [Shadows] was etched on the left side of his obsidian robe as he emanated grand power!

This was the Grand Primeval Silas of the Cult of Endless Shadows- the holder of multiple Dynamis of Extremity who was currently put in charge of overseeing the matters of the Cult of Endless Shadows in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution!

Yet towards his words and prestige- in front of multiple other Apex Aeonic Lifeforms...the True Emperor of Quintessence whose sandy gold Clone was surrounded by streams of abundant milky white essence of Conquests...this being gazed towards Grand Primeval Silas with eyes of immense confidence and tyranny as he spoke out clearly!
"It is merely the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms of a mere Inheritance barely Recorded across the Aeonic Annals of Extremity. Why would I ever show even an ounce of fear towards such beings?"

'Focus on me...' His eyes released a grand golden light as just like he expected...
BZZT!
Besides the Apex Aeonic Lifeform that appeared first, multiple more came in one after another until 9 dazzling auras caused the surrounding space to creak and tremble.
One aura exceedingly stronger than the rest appeared at the forefront as Noah recognized the figure of Lineage Emperor Roan beside him from the many memories he had obtained from Lernaeans!
His eyes became sharp as a devilish smile bloomed on his face.
Even though he stared at frightening Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, he spoke out freely.
"Well, isn't this a special day.
To have the Lernaean Lineage Emperor Roan himself and multiple other Apex Aeonic Lifeforms lock down space just for me..."

The pressure of the entities before him increased a hundredfold as none of it was localized on him, the covering on the strongest aura here lifted as a handsome man surrounded by darkness unveiled himself with a calm smile as well.
"The unruly Descendant that holds Consummate Boundaries...do I really not see even an ounce of fear as you stand before esteemed Lifeforms from the Cult of Endless Shadows?"
His demeanor was just as overbearing as he didn't even leave room for Roan to impose himself.
Hair as black as night and eyes that seemed like singularities of darkness.
A dazzling rune of [Shadows] was etched on the left side of his obsidian robe as he emanated grand power!

This was the Grand Primeval Silas of the Cult of Endless Shadows- the holder of multiple Dynamis of Extremity who was currently put in charge of overseeing the matters of the Cult of Endless Shadows in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution!

Yet towards his words and prestige- in front of multiple other Apex Aeonic Lifeforms...the True Emperor of Quintessence whose sandy gold Clone was surrounded by streams of abundant milky white essence of Conquests...this being gazed towards Grand Primeval Silas with eyes of immense confidence and tyranny as he spoke out clearly!
"It is merely the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms of a mere Inheritance barely Recorded across the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
Why would I ever show even an ounce of fear towards such beings?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2398 Of Light And Shadows! I
paragraphs: "It is merely the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms of a mere Inheritance barely Recorded across the Aeonic Annals of Extremity. Why would I ever show even an ounce of fear towards such beings?"
BOOM!
Shocking!
Indomitable!
This was the only word one could think of while watching the visage of the True Emperor of Quintessence who floated in the skies while 9 Apex Aeonic Lifeforms made their presence clear!
His words were astonishing as when Grand Primeval Silas heard them, his shadowy smile only became wider as his eyes radiated unbound darkness.
The visage of Roan beside him had a cold expression as with his identity as the Lernaean Representative, it was his duty to Discipline those of his Lineage!
So before anything else could occur, his voice emanated out.

"A descendent like you that has only just risen up may not know when and where to show fear...but such a time is now. Do not say anything else more foolish and forget whatever Orion has told you. Our Lineage now follows the Cult of Endless Shadows, and so do you. Fall in line and contribute to the elevation of Lernaeans, or make a futile struggle and find only darkness waiting for you."
A grand violet haze wrapped around Roan as he spoke, where at the same time- his very body buzzed powerfully as he called forth his Bloodline Authority!
The authority as an Ancestral Lernaean whose blood covered the branch Lineages that rose in the 9 Dimensions and the Desolate Mausoleum.

And as the Apex Lernaean Lineage Emperor, this Authority was moreso magnified as it was one of the few things an Apex Aeonic Lifeform could utilize against juniors of his Lineage as a form of discipline without it breaking the unspoken rule of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms attacking lower Lifeforms!
For those of the same Bloodline, it was an irrefutable form of attack that they couldn't deny!
And before Noah's eyes...
[A Bloodline Authority with traces of compositions linked to a portion of the Bloodlines under you seeks to impose control!]
His eyes shone sharply a crimson glow erupted around him, his gaze turning towards Roan with utmost coldness as a multicolored radiance shone around him.
[The Lineage of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor admonishes the poor authority targeting its composition!]
His body shone with a multicolored radiance as it wasn't affected in the least bit, the glow around him making him seem like an untouchable creature graced with unwavering brilliance!
"I may have been born in the Barren Lands, but my Lineage is not something that the likes of you can claim to be Ancestors of."
WAA!
His voice was grand as Roan looked towards him with a trace of shock.I think you should take a look at
Was he actually not of a branch of their Lineage?
Even while such a question rose, the voice of the True Emperor of Quintessence continued to emanate out.
"You know what I see when I look at you? Your name and your distinctions fall under my gaze."
Providence shone brightly as the Aeonic Annals of Providence remained branded in Noah's eyes- boundless streams of information flowing into him even if the vast majority was restricted!
"There are grand and glorious titles such as the Apex Lernaean Lineage Emperor Roan and Grand Primeval Roan, but there is also something like the Deposed Emperor Roan!"
WAA!

His visage was dominating as he actually floated towards the 9 Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, his figure coming ever closer to them as even though 8 of them cast massive shadows extending in the distance, his brilliance seemed to be covering the endless expanse behind him as he spoke freely towards Roan.
"A fake Emperor like you dares to try and impose their authority onto me? Onto my Lineage that far supersedes yours?! Stand the fuck down and know your place, O Deposed Emperor!"
BOOM!
A light of glory shone around him as he came to float not too far away from existences as pristine as Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!
Within Roan's eyes, incredulity and bubbling rage rose as when had anyone ever spoken to him like this?
Even other Apex Aeonic Lifeforms didn't ever speak to him in such a manner as who did this being think he was?
His expansive rage was rising to such an unimaginably high level that Roan even had the thought...would the cost of killing this being be too high for him to bear if he acted at this moment?
But before such a thought could be carried out, clapping could be heard as loud laughter from Grand Primeval Silas could be heard.
"Haha, what a unrestrained personality! You're something that would be a great fit with our Cult of Endless Shadows."

The Endless darkness around Silas became restrained as he stared at Noah from a distance. His hand had risen towards Roan as he made his intentions clear, the Deposed Emperor remaining silent with rising rage as the stares of Silas and Noah locked onto each other.
"The Unruly Descendant...Osmont, is it? I know your type."
"Oh?" Noah's gaze was frosty as his hands remained behind his back cooly while Silas nodded and continued.

"Yes. Geniuses who haven't really faced all that much adversity towards the Boundary Expansion Realm. Over the years, you've built up your confidence as you overcame one weak enemy after another, giving you a fake sense of invincibility as you've never really been knocked down. Words will not work on you as you will only continue to express rudeness and apathy. No...the only thing that will work on you is a very clear demonstration of power. For you to be shown that the Havens are vast. For you to be shown that you aren't the only Genius out there. That there are other Unequaled Reverend Emperors out there just as powerful if not more powerful than you. Mutated Souls with even more unique qualities. What you need...is to be shown for the first time in your life that you are not special. You need to be knocked down."
The expansive Shadow that was restrained behind him began to expand again, this time showing countless figures within it that released terrifying waves of power!

chapters.title: Chapter 2399 Of Light And Shadows! II
paragraphs: The smile on Grand Primeval Silas was chilling as he continued.

"But do not worry. After I knock you down, I will lift you up again and rebuild your confidence as a member of the Cult of Endless Shadows. As the Shadowlings you will now face who will be the ones to expand your vision and show you that in the vastness of Extremity...you really aren't too special!"
BOOM!
The shadow extending behind him spat out dozens of figures that radiated immense power below the stage of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!

Each one was an Unequaled Reverend Emperor as 36 Shadowlings appeared behind Grand Primeval Silas, their eyes releasing a profound light of power as they were akin to the enemies Noah was facing in the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands right above the periphery of the Extremity Vein of Dissolution.
He gazed at their appearance and smiled as he replied lightly.

"You cannot act against me, so you call upon these poor souls to teach me a lesson? To show me that I am not special within these vast Havens? Hah! All you have done is bring out creatures that will fall under my feet like many others in the past."
He pointed to the powerful members of the Cult of Endless Shadows that had just appeared as he spoke with utmost solemnity.
"All you have done is bring your people to my door for them to die."

His dominance never once falter as of the newly appearing Shadowlings, three stood out the brightest as they immediately blazed with powerful Haki that contained the essence of multiple Consummate Boundaries!
"Control your tongue, otherwise even after your beatdown and subsequent assimilation into our Cult of Endless Shadows, you will only remain an outcast with no allies."
WAA!

The one to speak was a tall and slender woman with hair steeped in darkness, her beauty on different scales entirely as beside her, the auras of the two other most powerful Shadowlings bound her left and right as they were men of powerful stature!
One held an obsidian bow pulsing with the aura of an Apex Aeonic Relic, another grasping a massive hammer wrapped in darkness that pulsed with a similar aura.

"Haha, Rosalind...as I've just said, this is not a being that words will work on. He will only be convinced when reality hits him in the face...so show him. Show him that out of the vastness of Extremity, he isn't the only one blessed with gifts."
A command came from above as the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms became concealed by shadows.
"Yes, Grand Primeval."

The one called Rosalind nodded as the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms disappeared- the reason for this being that they had already played too much of a hand against this being before them already! Their souls could feel that if they moved any further and continued to press their oppressive auras down on him even after they called forth Unequaled Reverend Emperors, the Extremity Adjudicator would be justified to make a move as for now...they could only watch.
HOONG!
From the Shadowling Rosalind, a pillar of darkness rose around her as her fair skin slowly became inky black and took on a shadowy luster, her voice echoing out.

"I am a Haven Rank Shadowling of the Cult of Endless Shadows, and I shall show you the heights of the Havens and the depths of the Earth today. Mateo, Starr...take your squadrons to surround him. What we seek today is complete submission to make this being understand that he cannot insult a Grand Primeval of our Cult."
They were meant to join many other beings in the Extremity Vein of Dissolution to seek Extremity Panaceas and other boons to complete their foundations.
To be recalled here to deal with a single overconfident being made their hearts extremely bitter as all it did was take away from their time and opportunities!
So they sought to finish this fast as the being they surrounded smiled brilliantly at this moment.
"You all seem to think you can call others to fight for you, but I cannot."I think you should take a look at
Even in this situation, his confident eyes never faltered as he stared in the direction of the concealed Apex Aeonic Lifeforms who still had this space locked down!
"I will show you all today that the beings you've called out to suppress me...I will not even have to lift a finger against them."
WAA!
"I'll actually sit back and show you all who think you've seen the vastness of Extremity...that you haven't seen anything yet!"
BZZZT!
Brilliance flashed around him as a sandy gold throne of Dreams rose, his visage sitting on it as on top of this, the pure and unbound essence of Consummate Boundaries leaked madly around him.
Within the depths of the Source of Reality of the Infinite Plane.
Noah's main body rose its glorious visage upwards towards the aurora of surging essence around him as he spoke out.
"It is time to release them and let their names be Recorded in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity."
He spoke towards the Infinite Plane itself.
He spoke towards the tools that were uniquely tied to itself.
He spoke of the weapons that had been recalled into the Source of Reality after their battle was done- he spoke of the Enders of Nature that were born of the very Natural Laws themselves!
Natural Laws that were now each standing at the 9th Boundary Layer of Extremity!

One must not forget, Noah bound the Sources of all the Boundaries he held- the Natural Laws included. But there was another Entity that helped him in this binding as it was even more closely interlinked to these Laws!
If during Noah's elevation, he could obtain the Reified Sources of Extremity as he called out reified forms of his Boundaries, how could the Infinite Plane not be able to do so?
ROAAR!

From the overabundance of multicolored light within the Source of Reality, the bellow of the Draconian Qilin Phoenix cleared the scene as it displayed dense clusters of Enders of Nature that now had at their base...bodies that were remade with the Sources of Extremity bound to the Infinite Plane.
There wasn't a mixing of different Boundary Essences yet as this was too advanced at this junction.
The dazzling Draconian Qilin Phoenix didn't hold multiple Essences of the past natural laws around it as it only shone with a glorious cerulean glow of Manadynamics.
Within its body, every atom was remade through the Source of Manadynamics!
It, and all the others behind it...were no longer mere Enders of Nature.
Noah's eyes were bright as he gazed beside the Draconian Qilin Phoenix to see the countenance of the Draconic Elephantine creature that was the past Hyperion as he voiced out grandly.
"Release the Reified Enders of Extremity."
BOOM!
