chapters.title: Chapter 2409 Lineage Emperor Osmont II
paragraphs: "If you seek the tools to help you achieve Extremity- you can come to me at any time!"

A shocking set of words were released from the newly enthroned Lernaean Lineage Emperor Osmont as while facing existences more powerful than the current him...he actually offered them aid towards achieving Extremity!

Silas' eyes turned dark at this as he didn't expect Noah to try stretching his influence even past their deal, but this didn't violate anything as for the sake of the future relationship with this Mutated Entity and his eventful inclusion as a Shadowling, Silas allowed this without interfering.

Not too far for him, he continued to place his pressure on the visage of Roan to make sure thing being didn't erupt, where at this point in time- Roan harrumphed while a spatial vortex wrapped around him, his figure entirely disappearing!
Noah only spared this a glance as he smiled while his figure also began to become transparent on the sandy gold throne.
"My throne will be here for any of those that wish to get in contact. For now...I must tend to complete the relocation of the Lernaean Domains."

He gazed upon the slightly confused and disbelieving faces of the grandiose Apex Aeonic Lifeforms around him as after nodding towards Genesis and Aurelia, his figure entirely disappeared- only leaving behind a single golden throne that symbolically floated at the very center of this domain!
As soon as he left, Silas looked towards the masses of beings around him and spoke with sharp eyes.

"I look forward to working with everyone here. The triumph of the Lernaean Lineage is after all, the success of the Cult of Endless Shadows. If you all wish for even greater types of might and even experiencing something as Grand as an Armament of Extremity...my entryways are always open."
His words were similar to Noah's as they seemed magnanimous, Aurelia releasing a snort at this moment as she disappeared- soon to be followed by Genesis while discussions broke out in this domain.
"Just what..."

Above the Argentate Sacrarium- one of the most important locations for Ancestral Lernaeans within the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution where below it- the Minor Plane containing the Domain that a newly crowned Lineage Emperor was just crowned.

The earth below remained covered deeply by a vast silver sea of Nullity, crystalline silver mountains rising up as their peaks were constantly smashed with waves of Nullity and forged to become ever stronger.

The beings of armored Lernaeans with pickaxes releasing the light of EPOCH Relics could be seen mining the crystalline mountains to harvest materials even now, some working under the silver sea with some seen on the peak of mountains as each of them were accomplished beings in the Boundary Expansion Realm!

The figure of Roan could be seen in the skies thundering with tendrils of Nullity amidst all this as he stared down towards the silver sea below and the Major Plane of Existence hidden deep underneath it.
The rage within his eyes was palpable as at this moment, the figure of Genesis came to appear behind him while gazing towards the expanse below as well!
"I called you a fool and knew you would come to regret your choices, but I never expected it to happen this fast."
Orion's words came out straight as they only further enraged Roan, his face staring straight as he bellowed out without even gazing back.
"If you came here to gloat, save it! I am in no mood, Genesis."
"I am not here to gloat." Orion's voice was calm as he stared at the far away Lernaean Domain while the memories of what he was currently seeing in the Infinite Plane flowed in his mind.

"I'm here to tell you not to make any more foolish choices. Fall in line as if it is not for the Lernaean Lineage, then for your own sake. The one you called an Unruly Descendant who usurped your throne and everything you had less than an hour...I understand him very little as you cannot even begin to grasp him. What he now means to the Lernaean Lineage far exceeds you and what you meant all these years. If you make any foolish choices towards him again...he won't have to even lift a finger. I will be the first one to move- this, I promise you!"
WAA!
Crackling nullity resonated with his words as after he uttered what he needed to do, his figure disappeared soon after!I think you should take a look at
All that was behind was the appearance of Roan amidst tendrils of Nullity.
His figure seemed desolate- the figure of s being that had both gained and lost everything within a span of a day!
In the Planar Palisades of Extremity.
A construct the size of a grain of sand shone with utmost brilliance in an insignificant corner of these Palisades as it underwent stupendous transformations!

For the first time in the past days, Noah's Main Body left the Source of Reality where he was enclosed in as he appeared above the 9 Dimensions and massive clusters of the Realities and Cosmos that used to be the Desolate Mausoleum.
In the surroundings of all this, Noah could see the formation of massive new Planes as his commands continued to be relayed to the Infinite Plane!
"Choose from the Templates of already devoured Planes and keep a record of each of them as well as their qualities. I may use the Templates in the future..."
Of the Planes being built, some held dazzling hints of silver Nullity, others head Ruin, and then there were some Planes...that shine with the light of the Natural Laws of Reality!
A plane filled with the multicolored luster of Relativity.
A plane filled with the blue luster of Manadynamics as it was akin to a vast stellar cerulean sea!
A plane releasing a golden light as Providence shone brightly from it!
Within these Planes, Reified Enders of Extremity would be born and raised.
His people would delve into them to deeply sense their essence of Extremity and achieve even grander stages of power.
As Quintillions and Quintillions more Lernaeans arrived into the Infinite Plane having already pledged Fealty, Noah only felt the concentration of the blinding light of Conquest growing ever higher!
He looked at the many changes around the Infinite Plane as he knew this was it.
The tool for him to use for his domination and conquest.
The tool that was already swallowing one of the Lineages within the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution as the others would surely follow!
This tool would be a grand part of his Foundation as it would be a weapon he would use against the ancient Inheritances already established across the Havens before he swallowed them up.
And to do so, he also had to enact his own stupendous Inheritance that would hold monstrous existences that others could only imagine.
"My Inheritance..."
He thought of himself and what he stood for as when it came to the Inheritance he would establish... everything for it was already set in stone!

chapters.title: Chapter 2410 Two Different Forges I
paragraphs: As he stared at the expanse of transformations of the Infinite Plane and theorized possibilities for the future, he felt a blazing aura erupt behind him as a sonorous voice rang out soon after.
"Mmm, so this is your main body."
The visage of the dazzling Aurelia appeared behind him as her golden hair draped way past her shoulders, her figure utterly dazzling to look at as Noah was unfettered at her appearance.
"Yes, so what?"

"You really aren't afraid of us to so easily show your main body? Even with the countermeasures you've supposedly taken, the will of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform can move extremely fast when they wish to attack." Her eyes shone like golden suns as she spoke lazily, probing into Noah as he shook his head freely while turning to gaze at the expansion of planes around him.
"You wouldn't be able to kill me even if you tried. Maybe someone who has reached Extremity has a chance of doing so."
Yes!
Just who could kill him now?
His life was tied to the Infinite Plane as if its Source wasn't destroyed, he wouldn't be destroyed!
And going even further past this, if he manifested the 9 Dimensions around him- he also couldn't perish until they did so!
Along with the countermeasures he had already taken against Aurelia and Orion, he wasn't the least bit worried.
The laziness in Aurelia's eyes lifted slightly as she straightened up while instantly appearing opposite to Noah.
"Speaking of Extremity, will you truly aid the Lernaean Apex Aeonic Lifeforms towards Extremity?" Aurelia asked with a hint of skepticism as Noah smiled lightly.

"Do you think I will so simply aid those who sat on their thrones and passed the verdict of Cataclysm on the Barren Lands and in extension myself? No, if they seek anything from me...they can only get it by pledging fealty!"
WAA!
Nothing could have been decided unless the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms made a verdict with the majority similar to how the recent votes took place.
For those who had made this choice, Noah wouldn't let them off lightly as the Elder Ancestors across the Lernaean Domains...Noah was already conquering them through his sheer will!
All that was left were the Lernaean Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.
They would have to grovel beneath his feet and make a pledge of Fealty to attain anything from him!
"Ah, Orion was locked up at the time, and I voted No when I eventually heard about it. I should be excluded from this power trip, yes?"
Her golden eyes blinked innocently as she asked, Noah focusing on this past True Emperor who spent most of her time secluded as he asked coldly.
"What do you want?"

"I'll ignore your tone since I'm still very intrigued to see what you've done with the base of my Golden Forge. I told you that I would make the first move by showing you mine and you can then show me yours. Since things are somewhat settling down now, I can't wait much longer."

The laziness was all but fading in her eyes when she talked about the Golden Forge, Noah's luminous eyes staring at her with scrutiny as when he thought of his own Forge that was benefitting from the elevation of his soul, he was still very curious of the direction this being took hers in- and how vastly different it was under the grandeur of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform!I think you should take a look at
"Very well."
HUUM!
So he grandly spoke during this period of immense transformations.
"Let me inside you."
With his cosmic grandeur surging wildly, he finally agreed to the exchange of ideas the True Emperor of Fortune sought so much as the sun- like eyes of Aurelia brightened up entirely!
Her grandeur of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform seemed greatly reduced as with an expression of someone wishing to show off, her forehead began to bloom with a dazzling golden light.

"Send a sliver of your soul in. My Aeonic Forge of Extremity has no set nexus in dimension or time as you can enter it through any extension of my soul. Don't be too surprised at what you find there!"

Excitement was prevalent in her eyes as it seemed like for the first time ever, she could share her love of Loot with someone who shared a similar mindset and even managed to make a Forge similar to hers!
Noah closely studied the facial expression of this existence as without fear, a multicolored ball of light moved from his body and sank into the golden blooming light on Aurelia's forehead.

This portion of his Soul then faced an unprecedented movement as it warped into the very soul of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform- seemingly traversing through an endless sea as he was led to one singular point of halcyon light!
After this blinding light went down, the environment gradually became apparent as his soul descended towards a massive golden mountain that made him seem like an ant in comparison.
BZZT!
Streams of golden loot light gradually descended on this mountain in an austere and beautiful show of wonder.
His figure stabilized at the bottom of this mountain as at his feet, crystals pulsing with dense essence of Extremity were laid out as if they were mere trash.

Entrenched in a field of these crystals, dozens of EPOCH Relics could be seen here and there as when gazing upwards towards this mountain, one could see a variety of different Loot stretched out all around!
They ranged in grandeur and sizes as on the left, Noah could see massive golden Vessels and even cosmic sized statues releasing vibrant glimmers of light.
And everything only seemed to get brighter as one went up the mountain as higher up, Noah could sense heavy auras that could only represent Apex Aeonic Relics!
And at its peak- a blinding light shone that Noah's soul had yet to pierce through.
"I've always gone back and forth on the form that my Forge took."
The voice of Aurelia rang out with a hint of enthusiasm as a appearance of hers manifested beside Noah.

"A millennium ago, it was in the form of a treasure chest as every time I came in, it was like opening a enormous cache of wonders to take what I wanted. The time before that, I had clusters of islands each holding different Loot...I change it up every now and then as this time, it is a mountain of Loot where the higher up you go, the more pristine the Loot becomes!"
Her voice was resonant across this whole dimension as her figure and Noah's began to scale up this mountain at this very moment!

"Mmm, so this is your main body."
The visage of the dazzling Aurelia appeared behind him as her golden hair draped way past her shoulders, her figure utterly dazzling to look at as Noah was unfettered at her appearance.
"Yes, so what?"
"You really aren't afraid of us to so easily show your main body?

Even with the countermeasures you've supposedly taken, the will of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform can move extremely fast when they wish to attack." Her eyes shone like golden suns as she spoke lazily, probing into Noah as he shook his head freely while turning to gaze at the expansion of planes around him.
"You wouldn't be able to kill me even if you tried.
Maybe someone who has reached Extremity has a chance of doing so."
Yes!
Just who could kill him now?
His life was tied to the Infinite Plane as if its Source wasn't destroyed, he wouldn't be destroyed!
And going even further past this, if he manifested the 9 Dimensions around him- he also couldn't perish until they did so!
Along with the countermeasures he had already taken against Aurelia and Orion, he wasn't the least bit worried.
The laziness in Aurelia's eyes lifted slightly as she straightened up while instantly appearing opposite to Noah.
"Speaking of Extremity, will you truly aid the Lernaean Apex Aeonic Lifeforms towards Extremity?" Aurelia asked with a hint of skepticism as Noah smiled lightly.
"Do you think I will so simply aid those who sat on their thrones and passed the verdict of Cataclysm on the Barren Lands and in extension myself?
No, if they seek anything from me...they can only get it by pledging fealty!"
WAA!

For those who had made this choice, Noah wouldn't let them off lightly as the Elder Ancestors across the Lernaean Domains...Noah was already conquering them through his sheer will!
All that was left were the Lernaean Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.
They would have to grovel beneath his feet and make a pledge of Fealty to attain anything from him!
"Ah, Orion was locked up at the time, and I voted No when I eventually heard about it.
I should be excluded from this power trip, yes?"
Her golden eyes blinked innocently as she asked, Noah focusing on this past True Emperor who spent most of her time secluded as he asked coldly.

chapters.title: Chapter 2411 Two Different Forges Il
paragraphs: Noah's will spread out across the Aeonic Forge of Extremity where his size was currently the same as one of the innumerable crystals stretched out across this Endless mountain, his eyes picking up the identity of a variety of Loot of Aurelia continued to speak while bringing their bodies to a portion of the Forge that pulsed with a dense clustered aura of Extremity.
She reached out to grab a transparent cubical crystal at this moment.

"This is the [Aeonic Dynamis Illuminator] that began generating in my forge after I became an Apex Aeonic Lifeform- it allowed me to test which of my Boundaries had the greatest compatibility as when utilizing a sufficient number of them, they can aid you in the formation of a Dynamis of Extremity..."
"Oh, and this is [The Fortune of Extreme Greed], it allows you to exchange the Boundary Layers of one Boundary into another..."
"This is..."

Their figures flew across the massive mountain as Aurelia talked nonstop, her demeanor making one forget her grandeur as an Apex Aeonic Lifeform as Noah's eyes lit up brightly with appreciation at all the new Loot he saw!
Viewing such things could always provide him 'references' for the Loot he would have forming in his own Infinite Forge after all.

"Oh, and this is a good one. This bad boy is the [Artificial Intelligence Meridian Theorizer], it allows Unequaled Reverend Emperors to run simulations of their Apexification before they truly proceed with it, with the simulations running at least a thousand times the computational speed of an average Reverend."

Their figures came to a stop before a massive glass like circular innovation that had tendrils of mechanical hands all around- simply waiting for someone to enter it as they held sharp ends ready to connect onto their bodies and souls!
"Interesting..."

Noah nodded as he looked at this and more marvels within the Aeonic Forge of Extremity as while they traversed across the mountain, his gaze continued to be drawn over to the peak where the blinding light was.
He interrupted Aurelia's words that were about to come out as he asked.
"Up there on the peak...what do you have there?"

"..oh? You can feel it too, huh?" Her ears and eyes perked up excitedly as she instantly carried their figures towards the top of this vast mountain, the blinding light gradually being repressed and allowing for the item hidden underneath to be seen as Aurelia spoke about it as it was unveiled.

"My greatest creation. A Relic that I was using before I attained the seat of True Emperor of Fortune, and one that I anchored to my Forge to automatically swallow a percentage of all the Loot formed for the past few billion years. It exceeds any other Apex Aeonic Relics as if I equip this while fighting someone who holds even a dozen Dynamis of Extremity...I should be able to come out on top!"
WAA!
A wondrous set of words came out of her as before their eyes, a vibrant white gold necklace surrounded by pulsing streams of Dynamis of Extremity showed itself.
It seemed like hundreds of intricately designed diamonds were weaved together, each one releasing a light as if it were a dazzling Plane of Existence that contained countless mysteries.
Strings of such dazzling diamonds were connected together as when worn by any woman- they would forever cause all others near them to seem dull in comparison!
"I call it...[The Riviere of Fortune]."
Noah's eyes locked onto this dazzling Loot as he asked with sharp eyes.
"You said you anchored this Relic in your Forge and had it inactively swallow a percentage of all forming Loot?"
"Yes, otherwise this mountain would be ten times as large with things that I don't need nor use. With this, I can be a little bit more optimized..."

She spoke cheerfully as Noah wasn't listening to her anymore, thinking about a certain Relic that always seemed to get left behind a day or two after its most recent upgrade.I think you should take a look at

He thought of the tool he had obtained from the Dark Universe- the cosmic treasure that was being utilized by Sages and Great Sages of the Primordial Cosmos and the initiator of apocalypse through their actions- something that Noah had then taken from scratch and put together its Cores before raising it to what it was today!
He thought of RUINATION.

One of the first physiques he attained was the Universal Origin Physique that first allowed him to use RUINATION, and it had taken a backseat for too long since his Conquest of the Havens of Extremity began.

If he connected it to his Infinite Forge and allowed it to absorb some or all of the Sources of boundless Loot forming within it always...its ranking would never fall behind again as the loss that Ruination had against the Infinite Plane...there lay a possibility for it to return on the spotlight!
"Hey. Hey, your eyes are sparkling. Did my words give you an epiphany? How about we treat that as a favor and you now show me your Forge?"
Beside him, Aurelia smiled brilliantly as Noah turned towards her carefully.
"From your own words, I can take one thing from your Forge?" He spoke while gazing towards the dazzling Reviere of Fortune as the smile instantly faded from Aurelia.
"Not fucking that. Are you crazy? I'll recommend something for you after I get to see your Forge. Let's go."

The mountain before their eyes gradually began to fade as very quickly, Noah's figure was pulled away from this space in the depths of Aurelia's Soul, very quickly exiting her forehead and returning to his main body!
He then saw the expectant face of Aurelia being right before his eyes, the excitement within them not being able to be hidden.
"Well? Let's go. I've shown you mine. I want to see how differently you changed my forge, how you structured it, and what Loot there is..."

This unique existence only had the thought of Loot in her eyes as Noah released a slight smile while waving his hands to show the weaving of a magnificent Epitaph that showed the composition of the past Golden Forge and how he had altered it.
Aurelia was beginning to be absorbed into it before she shook her head angrily soon after!
"No! I told you I wanted to see the real thing, just let me into your Soul for a second..."
Seeing the dazzling figure of this being, Noah's devilish smile became even wider as he wouldn't do anything without receiving major gains.
So he spoke slowly while erasing the illusory scene of the epitaph.

"I could bring you in...but I want to get something in return apart from the promised Loot from your Forge that you just denied me. Instead of that, I'll need something even simpler- a promise from you to help me elevate the strength of my Soul and my progression towards forming my Dynamis of Extremity with a technique of my choosing."
"Oh? That's it?" Aurelia's eyes were perplexed as she nodded soon after with conviction, placing her hand on her bountiful chest as she nodded righteously!
"No worries, this I can promise!"
She wanted to see the profound changes in her construct of the Golden Forge as she nodded freely!
And the devilish smile on Noah only became wider as his head also shone brilliantly.
"Very well, I welcome you into my Infinite Forge..."

chapters.title: Chapter 2412 The Infinite Forgeof Extremity I
paragraphs: His head shone with astounding brilliance as he opened up a pathway to a place within the very depths of his soul- a place no existence other than him had ever been to as for better or worse, the second person would actually be Aurelia.
Caterina Aurelia Dismukes!
The past True Emperor of Fortune and arguably the most powerful Lernaean Apex Aeonic Lifeforms barring those currently not within the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution.

And she had achieved this level of strength not by fighting or working tirelessly over time, but simply by elevating her Golden Forge to become an Aeonic Forge of Extremity as her current level of power was owed to her sitting back and simply enjoying the boons from her Forge over the years.

Her nature was inherently lazy as when she had the chance to peer into the soul of another being that had taken what she made and turned it into something that he argued was even more profound...she was truly expectant to see it as she showed more emotions today than in the past millions of years combined.
The moment the pathway was formed, all of Aurelia's Soul Clone turned into a stream of golden light that barged in, her first instincts being that of shock as she noticed...
The breadth of the soul she was entering.
Its size was massive.

It wasn't something that even Unequaled Reverend Emperors should have as it felt like an endless sea, and it contained torrential waves of entropic chaos, bloody arcs of light, golden waves of grandeur, and so much more...but it was all kept together by a multicolored light that she recognized after interacting with this being.
Quintessence!
It caused the soul to release immense waves of radiance as the path she took was one that she would have to put slight effort in to drill through if she wished to do any harm.

But she stayed still as she was carried by a grand stream of golden light, her will being exposed to the beginning of a massive Epitaph as she saw the area she was being brought to...was only a part of this Epitaph!

'His Forge...is only a part of his Construct?!' Her red lips parted in shock as her overly strong soul captured everything with Clarity, feeling herself sucked into a massive lemniscate symbol as she was instantly taken into a domain not anchored anywhere in space and time!
SHAA!
A brief moment of light.
She then opened her eyes.

The first thing she saw was the visage of Noah beside her as his stellar strands of dark hair just barely grazed his broad shoulders, his body draped in a halcyon Emperor's Robe inscribed with innumerable Infinity symbols as his fair skin released pulsing waves of radiance.
It was a representation of his soul as it carried devilish grace and handsomeness, his pupils spinning like vibrant singularities whose lights formed into an Infinity symbol during their rotation!
This was him.
When Aurelia's eyes went to gaze at everything around them, her red lips parted even further and formed into an O at the sheer grandiosity before them.I think you should take a look at
Around them, four massive lemniscate symbols the size of Major Planes of Existence in relation to their current statures could be seen in all four directions.

Each one spun in the air as they released multicolored light wrapped in milky gold grandeur- the essence of Extremity patently wrapping around them as the essence of Loot, Providence, Destiny, Fortune, Manadynamics....the potent aura of multiple concepts of Extremity wrapped around these symbols tightly as they released extremely concentrated milky Loot light that cascaded away from these symbols!
And when this light reached a certain point, it transformed into genuine and brilliant Loot light that became something else entirely.
Aurelia could see crystalline shining singularities releasing a black light forming by the hundreds in one direction as she gasped when she saw it, her eyes wrapping around it quizzically.
"That...is an Aeonic Treasures that can instantly boost a Boundary by 6 Layers?!"
She came across Complete Obsidian Aeonic Pearls of Extremity as she gasped, her eyes going towards
another direction and seeing other Pearls of singularities shining with a crimson light!
"And those can expand a concept to the 8th or 9th Boundary Layer!"

She marveled at the Complete Crimson I, II, and III Aeonic Pearls of Extremity that were also forming from the multicolored light cascading down as what surprised her wasn't just that they existed- but the sheer number that were forming and those already stretched out around them!
This was because within the domain of the four massive Plane sized Infinity symbols, the whole cluster of the Forge she was looking at seemed like a stellar system.
Like a constantly moving construct where countless bundles of Loot were strewn about and moving in clumps as if they were stellar Cosmos spinning in a vast reality!
Just nearby, she could see radiant armors, swords, axes, and a myriad of other Relics that each ranged from EPOCH I to EPOCH IX.
She had similar treasure like this in her Forge, but the issue was that in this Forge- there seemed to be tens of thousands of such Loot!
It overwhelmed her by both amount and quality as radiant EPOCH Relics that even Reverends would adorn were strewn about as if they were nothing.
In another region, massive silver mountains of Ingots of Nullinium spun with glory as in other regions, a cerulean sea of Ingots of Mananium in the billions shone with blinding light!
Swirling within arm's reach at this moment, Aurelia's beautiful hands reached out as she pulled from a cluster of tens of rotating cosmic balls of light and obtained...
[Random Innate Boundary Pearl]
A Loot that could grant one a genuine Innate Boundary was truly grasped by her as tens of other such Loot floated away from her.

The sheer dazzling grade and amount of treasure spinning around her like cosmic bodies as well as the four massive Infinity symbols in the far distance caused her to spread her arms out in joy as her figure followed the pull of gravity to float and swim with the endless Loot around her!

She came across Complete Obsidian Aeonic Pearls of Extremity as she gasped, her eyes going towards
another direction and seeing other Pearls of singularities shining with a crimson light!
"And those can expand a concept to the 8th or 9th Boundary Layer!"

She marveled at the Complete Crimson I, II, and III Aeonic Pearls of Extremity that were also forming from the multicolored light cascading down as what surprised her wasn't just that they existed- but the sheer number that were forming and those already stretched out around them!
This was because within the domain of the four massive Plane sized Infinity symbols, the whole cluster of the Forge she was looking at seemed like a stellar system.
Like a constantly moving construct where countless bundles of Loot were strewn about and moving in clumps as if they were stellar Cosmos spinning in a vast reality!
Just nearby, she could see radiant armors, swords, axes, and a myriad of other Relics that each ranged from EPOCH I to EPOCH IX.
She had similar treasure like this in her Forge, but the issue was that in this Forge- there seemed to be tens of thousands of such Loot!
It overwhelmed her by both amount and quality as radiant EPOCH Relics that even Reverends would adorn were strewn about as if they were nothing.
In another region, massive silver mountains of Ingots of Nullinium spun with glory as in other regions, a cerulean sea of Ingots of Mananium in the billions shone with blinding light!
Swirling within arm's reach at this moment, Aurelia's beautiful hands reached out as she pulled from a cluster of tens of rotating cosmic balls of light and obtained...
[Random Innate Boundary Pearl]
A Loot that could grant one a genuine Innate Boundary was truly grasped by her as tens of other such Loot floated away from her.

The sheer dazzling grade and amount of treasure spinning around her like cosmic bodies as well as the four massive Infinity symbols in the far distance caused her to spread her arms out in joy as her figure followed the pull of gravity to float and swim with the endless Loot around her!

chapters.title: Chapter 2413 The Infinite Forgeof Extremity II
paragraphs: 'Sheesh...' Noah couldn't help but sigh when seeing the expression of pure joy and excitement on Aurelia weaving around the dense cluster of Loot.
He had seen many beautiful women in his life, but the soul of this being was utterly stunning to look at- especially when it showed such pure joy!

Her golden strands of hair seemed like innumerable reality that wrapped around her, the simple milky gold dress she had on amplifying every part of her as she moved to confirm every single Loot in this Endless expanse of spinning wonder with her own eyes.

The closer one was towards Extremity, the more pristine and beautiful they were. Aurelia took this to a whole different level as even Noah was taken back for a second- and it wasn't merely due to this beauty, but it was the unfettered expression of joy that someone free of worries showed.
Other beings didn't have the luxury of ever feeling and expressing this level of joy as they always had worries weighing down on their shoulders!

But this Apex Aeonic Lifeform who always kept to herself and didn't entangle herself in any relationships or conflicts could show such a pure expression- with Noah only being taken away from it due to the appearance of dazzling prompts booming before his eyes.
[The Infinite Forge of Extremity has been born after countless advancements and refinements with your Soul and the Essence of Boundaries of Extremity.]
[The Infinite Forge of Extremity is seeking the direction of future Loot from its Master.]
[95% of the accumulated Loot Light of the Infinite Forge of Extremity for the past 2 days has been preserved and can be utilized to transform into the Loot you specify.]
A wondrous prompt appeared before him as Noah couldn't help but smile.
He knew of his current foundation and what he needed the most to optimize his power and bring him ever close to Extremity!

At this stage, he could push aside other factors and bring forward the continued elevation of his Soul that boosted everything about him, his Lineage, and then the management of Boundaries and their fusion into Dynamis of Extremity.
Before he jumped into anything else, he wanted to complete the Convergence of Manadynamics and Nullity.

He also wanted to get his hands on the Extremity Circulation Modus Operandi that allowed Scions of Inheritances to display stupendous power- a methodology of circulating multiple Boundary Essenced together as this would lay the foundation for the smooth Convergence of Dynamis of Extremity in the future!

He recalled the option of choices of Loot when he killed the Shadowling before Silas intervened and his selection of the 1x Fragment of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi and 1x Aeonic Sanguine Pearl of Extremity.

He already had enough Complete Crimson III Aeonic Pearls of Extremity and as for the Fragments of the Shadow Extremity Circulation Modus Operandi- he would simply get this technique from Silas to use as a mere reference when he eventually makes the trip to observe the Armament of Extremity!I think you should take a look at

One of the more vital things was the Aeonic Sanguine Pearl of Extremity that would go towards elevating his Quintessential Kainos Emperor Lineage, and then the Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi that was a circulation method that the Boundary of Loot brought to light!

[Fragment of Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi]:: A Fragment of a methodology that has not appeared in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity. When 100 Fragments are gathered, the first Volume of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi will be completed as it allows one to smoothly circulate up to 24 different Boundary Essences across their every atom with a single breath. The harmony brought by each breath will shed light on the Boundaries harmonious for Convergence, and the efforts of every single breath can be focused on specific compatible Boundaries to increase their rate of Convergence towards becoming a Dynamis of Extremity. While others struggle to circulate a few Boundaries in harmony with huge concentration and effort, a mere breath from you will bring you ever closer to Extremity. To take a single breath while following the methodology of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi, an extremely strong Aeonic Soul is required as a prerequisite- along with a fortified Body and Origin. Unquantified possibilities are yet to be displayed regarding the Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi that will only be clearer once the first Volume is brought to fruition, with future Volumes holding immeasurable possibilities...
Yes.
Something just for him.

The Shadow Extremity Circulation Modus Operandi that Rosalind and the other 2 Shadowlings displayed that could circulate 4 Boundary Essences was utter trash compared to this as when it came to comprehensively raising Noah's strength...this tool that even Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity kept under lock and key was undoubtedly a first choice at this moment in time!
So towards the direction where his Infinite Forge of Extremity should go...
"Utilize as much of the accumulated Loot Light of the Infinite Forge of Extremity as needed towards forming 99 Fragments of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi."
BZZT!

Immense radiance overflowed as the four Infinity symbols all around blared out even more intense authority, Aurelia's figures looking at this in shock as after she heard Noah's words, her figure instantly flashed to appear before him with her innocent eyes shining like golden suns blinking over and over again.

"Breath of Extremity? Don't tell me that is an Extremity Circulation Modus Operandi...even I've barely managed to form rudimentary circulation methods that allowed me to form my Dynamis of Extremity! And you can just command your Forge to do this? Where is the wait time for such a Loot to generate? How did you even alter the Golden Forge construct to be capable of such outrageous Reality altering features? Hey? Hey!"

Her attention was divided into seeing what was about to be formed by a dazzling Loot Light while also seeking answers from Noah who had his eyes closed at this moment- his hand motioning out as apart from the Initial command of generating Fragments of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi, he was also focused on drawing a Relic deep into his Soul!
HUUM!
Crimson brilliance bloomed as drums of anticipation resounded.

The beat connected to the pulsing light forming dazzling Fragments as an instant later, a radiant figure of a woman with crimson skin etched with countless golden runic markings appeared at the center of the Infinite Forge of Extremity- the appearance of none other than RUINATION in her humanoid form coming to be as her eyes opened to release amazing brilliance!

chapters.title: Chapter 2414 The Infinite Forgeof Extremity III
paragraphs: Ruination was drawn into the Infinite Forge of Extremity as the moment her eyes opened, she called out with sadness towards the being who had neglected her.
"Master."
Her single word caused Noah to smile wryly as even Aurelia turned to look towards him with a hint of anger- wondering what he had done to cause this Relic to feel like so!
She waved her hand as Ruination's visage was instantly brought before them, Aurelia patting her pure crimson hair as she looked back and forth between her and Noah.
"It's okay. Tell Big Sis what this guy did. Did he promise you enhancements that he didn't keep you?"

She probed as her senses sank into Ruination to see just how unique this sentient Relic that had the rank of EPOCH was, but Ruination said nothing against her Master while Aurelia continued her probing!
"Hmm? For him to bring you into his Forge..."
Her quizzical eyes brightened up as if she had figured something out, her golden pupils that shine like suns becoming ever brighter as she laughed.
"Was that the epiphany you had after seeing my Reviere of Fortune? This Relic is important enough to you that you would anchor it to your Forge?"
The words caused Ruination to glow brightly as the conviction in her eyes slowly returned.
She had lost by too many factors to the Infinite Plane that she couldn't even face it as she used to anymore- she truly couldn't even compete with it at this point in time!
But she still wanted to continue to be of great use to her Master- for her to at least rise at the same pace and him and to continue multiplying his Loot or even to just be held in his hands again.

Being such a large part of his strength while he was rising and then not being able to do much for him as he stepped on the stage of Havens of Extremity hurt Ruination greatly as all of these emotions faded away the moment her Master called on her as she instinctively now knew...the elevation this time may not just be a one of thing as she would be surpassed a few days later.
So before the countenance of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform, Ruination sank to her knees as she voiced out with utmost loyalty.
"Let me be of use to you again, Master. Now and forever."

Her eyes and gaze were resolute as Noah nodded with bright eyes, his Will erupting out as while the four Infinity symbols spun and released waves of Loot light that began to form into Fragments of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi...
"Anchor Ruination to the nexus of the Infinite Forge of Extremity. Let her be bathed with the light of Loot and all the EPOCH Relics formed here so far..."
WAA!
There were many dazzling Relics swirling like resplendent stellar bodies in the surroundings already.
They and a whole lot more would be pulled towards Ruination as a path to make sure she wasn't left behind again unfolded!I think you should take a look at

Aurelia watched this happen with a smile as she observed the figure of Ruination become wrapped in a golden light and pulled towards the very center of the four Infinity symbols- glowing splendor wrapping around her as she metamorphosed into a magisterial Relic!
And in addition to all this...Providence shone within Noah's eyes as he motioned with his hands.
And a moment later, Aeonic Pearls of Extremity began to move towards the blinding light around Ruination!

Crimson III Aeonic Pearls of Extremity floated towards her as Noah wanted to see if this Relic that far surpassed other Relics in terms of the amount of will and autonomy she held...he wanted to see just how far she could go.
And since she was now the Ruined Blade of Epochal Quintessence that contained both the Origins of Ruination and Primordial Essence...
"Take the concepts of Ruination and Primordiality towards Extremity. Let's see just how far you can rise!"
As he spoke, the Sources of two Complete Crimson III Aeonic Pearls of Extremity also surged forth within his Origin as he focused on Ruination and Primordial Essence!

His distinction as the Quintessential Aeonic Curator was already actively working to make sure these concepts were no less than of the Golden Consummate Boundary Tier- a amazing action being taken in the Infinite Forge of Extremity at this moment!
Around this same time.
In swarming tendrils of nullity above the Argentate Sacrarium of the Ancestral Lernaeans.

The countenance of Silas wrapped in dense waves of shadows could barely be discerned as he stared at the countless lives hidden deep under the silver sea as well as the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms within its deeper domains.
He currently held a resplendent obsidian Runestone that released waves of terrifying darkness an instant later- a deep and ancient voice that caused all nearby light to be sucked in echoing out!
"Status report."
Silas instantly became serious as he spoke in a respectful tone towards the voice of one of the Extremity Shadows of the Cult of Endless Shadows.
"The Light of the Seven has fully integrated their forces with the aboriginals known as Planeswalkers. The Genesis Institute of Extremity has laid claim to the aboriginals known as
Noblesse, and the aboriginals known as Quasarians have not come to a decision- but they will likely ally with the Singularity Overseers over anyone else."

Silas relayed the happenings of the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution as he knew it, the Inheritances wishing to increase their boons within the Haven of Dissolution having made their moves as other Inheritances...either believed it wasn't worth it to fight for the alliances with aboriginals, or they believed in their power enough that they weren't even worried of the advantage that Apex Aeonic Lifeforms who had undergone Apexification in the Haven of Dissolution would have!

Some may even question...why did the myriad of Inheritances who wished to eventually participate in the Extremity Sanctification of the last Haven not send Unequaled Reverend Emperors to simply undergo Apexification in this Haven of Dissolution over the years and gradually build up their advantage?!

chapters.title: Chapter 2415 Indefatigable I
paragraphs: Why weren't the many Disciples of Inheritances wishing to seek fortune in the Youngest Haven when Extremity Sanctification began sent here to build up their power over the years?
After all, the Extremity Sanctification of the First Haven was a special one- and the Extremity Sanctification of the Last Haven was bound to be just as fantastical!

The answer to this...lay in the utter importance of the recognition and branding of the Haven one was in during their Apexification as those already in other stages of Extremity Sanctification provided immensely more benefit than what Dissolution could potentially come to provide later on.

There were even a myriad of Inheritances with many Unequaled Reverend Emperors ready to undergo Apexification as they waited to see how grand the results of the Initiation Step of the Extremity Vein of Dissolution would be before deciding to put their forces and efforts into the Culmination Step where the might of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms would come into play.
Some were even planning on utilizing the Scions participating in the Initiation Step to attain Extremity Panaceas for these purposes!
There were many different methods... but the end result would always be determined by a single factor.
Power!

Even if those undergoing Apexification in the Haven of Dissolution had an advantage, if they faced an Apex Aeonic Lifeform who held multiple Dynamis of Extremity with multiple Boundaries at the 10th Boundary Layer...would it really matter?!
But the up and coming Cult of Endless Shadows made its moves as at this moment, the Extremity Shadow of Immeasurable Darkness asked Silas.
"And our progress?"
At such a question, Silas steeled himself as he began speaking slowly.

"I came across a Mutated Entity without an Inheritance, and yet he held over a dozen Consummate Boundaries and showed prowess rivaling if not exceeding top ranked Disciples of Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity. He has even begun the Convergence of a Dynamis of Extremity as to tie this talent towards our Cult...I made an Oath of Extremity."
"What?"
BZZZT!

A single word came from the other end as Silas felt a heavy and inescapable pressure, very quickly explaining the sequence of events as well as the contents of his Oath as when the Extremity Shadow of Immeasurable Darkness heard everything, he remained silent thereafter!
Silas took the silence as a good thing as a sigh rang out with words following it soon after.

"There don't seem to be any loopholes as achieving Extremity in 10 years is impossible even with your talent, even if we gave you the Shadow Sword for all those 10 years. But even though it is impossible, that is exactly what Extremity seeks to achieve... impossibility. I wish you came to me before you made the Oath as I could've confirmed how it would play out, but nobody can peer into the possible results now with the involvement of the Oath of Extremity. Very well...you shall bear all responsibility for this. We will see how things go with the procurement of the Extremity Panaceas for the Shadowlings first..."
The words caused the immense pressure on Silas to slowly fade as he nodded with a smile!
"Understood!"
He looked forward to the future.
There were bound to be many benefits and surprises for his Cult of Endless Shadows!

Aurelia stared intently as a Relic was anchored at the very center of a stunning Forge, streams of multicolored light wrapping around her smoothly as the light of already formed EPOCH Relics also went towards her to be absorbed.I think you should take a look at
This was already fantastical enough, but her heart was pulsing when she watched the tens of Fragments forming near this same region that released an air of profound Extremity!
Pieces of Extremity Circulation Modus Operandi.

The tool that the most powerful Inheritances kept tightly guarded and utilized to circulate a myriad of Boundaries in unique ways, achieving stupendous results in the form of Dynamis of Extremity as this...all went towards their members achieving Extremity!
But...then what?
Was it truly worthy to be excited for what came as one became a powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeform and even those lucky enough to reach Extremity?
When Aurelia thought of this, her free heartfelt suppressed as a feeling of oppression she had felt a long time ago returned!
Her head turned to stare at the being focused on the formation of Loot as she felt like he was similar to her in their mindset. It was why he was able to revolutionize her Forge, after all.
Maybe he would be able to understand her.
"Do you...know why Inheritances and ancient factions run around recruiting as many beings as possible to bolster their power? Why all the Havens are so intent on Extremity?"

Her question caught Noah off guard as he turned towards her with bright eyes, his expression calm as he continued gazing at the forming Fragments of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity while he replied.
"I have an idea."
An idea of what lay ahead.
Aurelia laughed ruefully at this as she opened her hands wide and floated back into a cluster of Complete Obsidian Aeonic Pearls of Extremity.

"When you reach Apexification, they'll forcefully tell you the whole picture. They'll tell you what responsibilities you now hold and what to look for in your future. Do you know how frustrating it was for me to spend a few billion years living freely how I liked, secluded and surrounded by my treasures, and the moment I reach a grand stage of might and undergo Apexification...I am imposed restrictions tighter than any freedom I had prior?"
WAA!
Her strands of golden hair danced on the dazzling circles of singularities around her.
Her fair skin illuminated with golden light as her sun like eyes looked dimmer than before!

"Achieving greater stages of might should've come with even more freedom, but I've to realize it's the opposite. Even if you reach Extremity... the weight around you only gets heavier. It makes one contemplate whether it's worth it to tirelessly and indefatigably pursue greater strength. Whether one should truly even seek Extremity."

Her wide eyes blinked as it seemed like two suns were brightening and dimming at the same time, Noah taking his stare away from the formation of Loot as he turned to closely look at this being whose carefree smile and expression were long replaced by anxiety...and even a hint of fear!
"Did you know that in these Seven Havens...the mortality rate of those who have reached Extremity is even higher than Apex Aeonic Lifeforms?"
BOOOM!
Horrific words emanated from her mouth as she raised her right hand up- trying to grasp something that seemed too far away!
"When looking at their total numbers and how many face death, the ratio is much greater for the mighty and powerful figures who should be those with the most freedom!"

sentences.text: Why weren't the many Disciples of Inheritances wishing to seek fortune in the Youngest Haven when Extremity Sanctification began sent here to build up their power over the years?
After all, the Extremity Sanctification of the First Haven was a special one- and the Extremity Sanctification of the Last Haven was bound to be just as fantastical!

The answer to this...lay in the utter importance of the recognition and branding of the Haven one was in during their Apexification as those already in other stages of Extremity Sanctification provided immensely more benefit than what Dissolution could potentially come to provide later on.

There were even a myriad of Inheritances with many Unequaled Reverend Emperors ready to undergo Apexification as they waited to see how grand the results of the Initiation Step of the Extremity Vein of Dissolution would be before deciding to put their forces and efforts into the Culmination Step where the might of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms would come into play.
Some were even planning on utilizing the Scions participating in the Initiation Step to attain Extremity Panaceas for these purposes!
There were many different methods... but the end result would always be determined by a single factor.
Power!

Even if those undergoing Apexification in the Haven of Dissolution had an advantage, if they faced an Apex Aeonic Lifeform who held multiple Dynamis of Extremity with multiple Boundaries at the 10th Boundary Layer...would it really matter?!
But the up and coming Cult of Endless Shadows made its moves as at this moment, the Extremity Shadow of Immeasurable Darkness asked Silas.
"And our progress?"
At such a question, Silas steeled himself as he began speaking slowly.

"I came across a Mutated Entity without an Inheritance, and yet he held over a dozen Consummate Boundaries and showed prowess rivaling if not exceeding top ranked Disciples of Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity.
He has even begun the Convergence of a Dynamis of Extremity as to tie this talent towards our Cult...I made an Oath of Extremity."
"What?"
BZZZT!

A single word came from the other end as Silas felt a heavy and inescapable pressure, very quickly explaining the sequence of events as well as the contents of his Oath as when the Extremity Shadow of Immeasurable Darkness heard everything, he remained silent thereafter!
Silas took the silence as a good thing as a sigh rang out with words following it soon after.
"There don't seem to be any loopholes as achieving Extremity in 10 years is impossible even with your talent, even if we gave you the Shadow Sword for all those 10 years.
But even though it is impossible, that is exactly what Extremity seeks to achieve... impossibility.
I wish you came to me before you made the Oath as I could've confirmed how it would play out, but nobody can peer into the possible results now with the involvement of the Oath of Extremity.
Very well...you shall bear all responsibility for this.
We will see how things go with the procurement of the Extremity Panaceas for the Shadowlings first..."
The words caused the immense pressure on Silas to slowly fade as he nodded with a smile!
"Understood!"
He looked forward to the future.
There were bound to be many benefits and surprises for his Cult of Endless Shadows!

Aurelia stared intently as a Relic was anchored at the very center of a stunning Forge, streams of multicolored light wrapping around her smoothly as the light of already formed EPOCH Relics also went towards her to be absorbed.I think you should take a look at
This was already fantastical enough, but her heart was pulsing when she watched the tens of Fragments forming near this same region that released an air of profound Extremity!
Pieces of Extremity Circulation Modus Operandi.

The tool that the most powerful Inheritances kept tightly guarded and utilized to circulate a myriad of Boundaries in unique ways, achieving stupendous results in the form of Dynamis of Extremity as this...all went towards their members achieving Extremity!
But...then what?
Was it truly worthy to be excited for what came as one became a powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeform and even those lucky enough to reach Extremity?
When Aurelia thought of this, her free heartfelt suppressed as a feeling of oppression she had felt a long time ago returned!
Her head turned to stare at the being focused on the formation of Loot as she felt like he was similar to her in their mindset.
It was why he was able to revolutionize her Forge, after all.
Maybe he would be able to understand her.
"Do you...know why Inheritances and ancient factions run around recruiting as many beings as possible to bolster their power?
Why all the Havens are so intent on Extremity?"

Her question caught Noah off guard as he turned towards her with bright eyes, his expression calm as he continued gazing at the forming Fragments of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity while he replied.
"I have an idea."
An idea of what lay ahead.
Aurelia laughed ruefully at this as she opened her hands wide and floated back into a cluster of Complete Obsidian Aeonic Pearls of Extremity.
"When you reach Apexification, they'll forcefully tell you the whole picture.
They'll tell you what responsibilities you now hold and what to look for in your future.

Do you know how frustrating it was for me to spend a few billion years living freely how I liked, secluded and surrounded by my treasures, and the moment I reach a grand stage of might and undergo Apexification...I am imposed restrictions tighter than any freedom I had prior?"
WAA!
Her strands of golden hair danced on the dazzling circles of singularities around her.
Her fair skin illuminated with golden light as her sun like eyes looked dimmer than before!
"Achieving greater stages of might should've come with even more freedom, but I've to realize it's the opposite.
Even if you reach Extremity... the weight around you only gets heavier.
It makes one contemplate whether it's worth it to tirelessly and indefatigably pursue greater strength.
Whether one should truly even seek Extremity."

Her wide eyes blinked as it seemed like two suns were brightening and dimming at the same time, Noah taking his stare away from the formation of Loot as he turned to closely look at this being whose carefree smile and expression were long replaced by anxiety...and even a hint of fear!
"Did you know that in these Seven Havens...the mortality rate of those who have reached Extremity is even higher than Apex Aeonic Lifeforms?"
BOOOM!
Horrific words emanated from her mouth as she raised her right hand up- trying to grasp something that seemed too far away!
"When looking at their total numbers and how many face death, the ratio is much greater for the mighty and powerful figures who should be those with the most freedom!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2416 Indefatigable II
paragraphs: "The percentage of death is actually that much greater for the mighty and powerful figures who should be those with the most freedom- does that make any sense? The profoundness of Extremity that makes any Apex Aeonic Lifeforms feel useless...for even such a power to die like so, what are we struggling so much for?"
Her eyes always seemed free of worries.

She was one of the most powerful Lernaean Apex Aeonic Lifeforms as she was revered by many! Yet even such a being was ground down by the immense pressure that came from whatever knowledge she was given when she succeeded in Apexification.

"When I learned of all this, I wanted to run away. I wanted to be lost in the Planar Palisades of Extremity and roam around without worry at whatever enemy- at whatever phenomenon could actually kill even those who have achieved Extremity. But...I haven't been able to do so. I haven't been able to cut off these fools who can barely take care of themselves..."

Swimming amidst golden bundles of Loot, Aurelia laughed wryly amidst a deep sense of desolation that she very quickly repressed and pushed down, shaking her head as she looked towards the area above them where tens of dazzling multicolored Fragments of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi were forming.
"Ah fuck, I got sentimental. Don't mind me." The smile she always showed began to return.
At this point in time, one couldn't see any of the fear or desolation she showed when she spoke of a subject that even she couldn't touch too much on!
Someone had to succeed in Apexification for them to learn everything fully.
This was part of the Oath she was bound to.
As she stared at the generation Fragments, Noah's Will thought of her words as his eyes remained the same.
Even while Aurelia showed the fear and a sense of loss at such a reality waiting for them, Noah's heart didn't waver or tremble, nor did he begin to feel any sense of pressure!
He would do what he always did.
He would do what he was best at- he would adapt to any impossible situation and overcome it!
So even in the face of the reality before him, he wouldn't fear. He wouldn't falter.
He thought of the word that Aurelia said.
'Indefatigable, was it?'
BZZZT!
His soul buzzed as the Infinite Forge of Extremity released boundless radiance.
[89% of preserved Loot Light of the Infinite Forge of Extremity has been used up to form 99 Fragments of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity.]
A fantastical sight that took Aurelia out of her stupor arose.

Noah's hand waved towards the dazzling multicolored Fragments before him as the 100th erupted from his solidified will and mixed in with the other pieces- a blinding light of resonance and grandeur erupting out as they all came together!
[The First Volume of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi has been generated.]
A massive scroll shining with magisterial multicolored grandeur unfolded, its page holding torrential runic ecritures that spoke of a language nobody apart from Noah would be able to understand!
A tongue that only after he read it and spread it to others could it be known!
It was Quintessential!
It was the Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi!
Towards this scripture laid our just for him, Noah bellowed out.
"Come!"I think you should take a look at
His hands motioned for it as it didn't come directly before him- it instead turned into countless golden waves of light that suffused across his soul.

The First Volume of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi had formed in his soul, and it was absorbed by his soul as an instant later, Aurelia's eyes opened in surprise as she felt her Aeonic Soul Clone pulled away from the Infinite Forge of Extremity.

In a fraction of a nanosecond, she found herself outside of Noah's main body once more as she stared at the devilishly handsome man adorned in a stellar multicolored Emperor's Robe- a man that at this moment seemed about to conduct an action that even the lowest of Lifeforms performed.
He...was about to breathe.

Because in the description of the Modus Operandi he had just absorbed, there was a single line laid out as he would fill the description himself as he experienced the splendor that he got a glimpse of from the description of the Fragments of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity.
[Quintessential Breath of Extremity- Volume 1]:: A breath of Quintessence, a move to Extremity.
A breath of Quintessence!
A move to Extremity!
There were no flowery words or abstruse techniques to understand.
He only...had to breathe, and he would take a move closer towards Extremity!

The phenomenon to unfold next caused the figure of Aurelia that was nearest to Noah to tremble as from afar, the will of Orion who was still operating the spatial vortices that teleported Noah's clones also gazed upwards in shock!

It wasn't just them as the Dimensional Rulers, the main bodies of Noah's closest family stretched out across the Infinite Plane, and even the quintillions upon quintillions of Lernaeans currently looking towards Maximilian in the Dream Dimension...
They all felt their Wills drawn towards a certain region towards the very top of the Infinite Plane as here, Noah's main body breathed in!
And this single action that took the span of a nanosecond to be completed...
HOOONG!
Caused the selected Essences of some of the past natural laws turned into Boundaries to surge torrentially towards his body.
The selected essences of some of the Dimensions turned into Boundaries fervently flooded towards him like nine Endless seas!

The myriad of Domain Spaces being forged as Planes of Existence that held the essences of Quintessence, Loot, Blood, Conquest, Nullity, Ruin... all totaling up to 20 Boundary Essences crazily flooded towards him within this span of a nanosecond as it felt like all the Sources of Essence of these concepts in the surroundings were sucked dry and made lifeless from this single breath!

All of it sank into Noah as within this short time span, these unquantified units of a myriad of Boundary Essences flourished on his head before following a unique pathway as they turned into countless streams of multicolored lightly that moved from the top of his head all the way to the soles of his feet, going upwards past his chest and lungs as thereafter- his nose expelled even brighter shades of these streams of light!
But in the single nanosecond that passed, something filled with profundity had occurred.
The 20 Sources of essence had turned into innumerable streams that crossed every single one of Noah's atoms.
Not his cells...but the very atoms!
A single cell had an approximation of 100 trillion atoms.
And within the body of a Rank F Existence, there were at the very minimum 50 Trillion Cells!
Noah's body that had undergone immeasurable transformations and elevations...the sheer number of cells alone were unquantifiable as the number of atoms were even more so.
Yet a single breath as designed by the Quintessential Breath of Extremity had passed the essence of 20 Boundaries in the span of a nanosecond!

chapters.title: Chapter 2417 Indefatigable III
paragraphs: In this span of a nanosecond, all of Noah's atoms encountered streams of 20 different Boundaries flowing smoothly through them- these boundaries undergoing a minuscule refinement of purity with every atom.
A minuscule refinement.

But when taking into account the trillions of atoms in a single cell and the trillions of cells within Noah's body, this minuscule refinement at every atop caused such immense and immeasurable purity that when this essence was breathed out by Noah...
BZZT!
The surroundings shuddered as it seemed like endless waves of multicolored light were released from him.

These waves instantly covered nearby regions as within a nanosecond, they covered all of the Infinite Plane as every single Cosmos, Reality, and Plane of Existence cheered and drank from the pristinely pure essence of concepts of Extremity!

This wasn't all as the skin of all existences felt this pure Boundary essence suffusing into them as if they expanded this Boundary...they felt their Boundary Layers begin to advance as they became ever closer to Extremity!
This effect was even privy to Orion and Aurelia as this was the reason for their shock.
[The first Breath of Quintessence has been taken.]
A prompt rose in Noah's mind as he didn't pay attention to anything else and moved by instinct.
After preselecting 20 Boundaries to course through him with a single breath, he added 2 more at this moment as from the very Cosmos of the Infinite Plane, crimson and white seas surged out.
Primordial Essence!
The Essence of Ruination!
They stemmed from concepts that were merely Supreme Cosmic Daos that controlled the workings of Cosmos.
Essences of the beginning and of the end.
Primordiality and Ruination!
States of Chaos like Ruin and Nullity were very much similar to Ruination, with Primordiality being very similar to Genesis...but where was the line of differences and variation? Did these
concepts differ greatly, or were they all leading towards the same thing?
If the concepts that used to govern Cosmos were expanded under the same light of Extremity similar to states of Verisimilitude like Ruin and Nullity, just what result would they usher forth?!
His mind seemed to instinctively want to know.
It wanted to find out!
And so Primordiality and Ruination joined the fray.
BOOOM!
And...the result was ushered forth at such a juncture.
He breathed.
His heart made a beat.
THUMP!
The myriad of Boundary Essences surged into every single atom that made up his body.
And he breathed again!
THUMP!
And his heart made a resounding beat!

Everything he did so, it felt like he drew out boundless sources of essence in the Infinite Plane before he filled it with even purer sources of essence, each breath only culminating to a grander and greater sense of wonder and power!

There were stupendous changes outwardly, but his body was undergoing the greatest change as it felt like everything was moving in conjunction, his heart resounding loudly with every breath as his aura rose to a magisterial level.
And in such a cycle...some of the boundary Essences smoothly circulated across innumerable atoms began to be pulled together in an intense and unfathomable process!
The streams of two in particular had an fierce reaction.
It was none other than Primordiality and Ruination.
Milky white and crimson streams clashed within a single atom out of the countless as an immediate later, Noah's visage illuminated with a milky crimson light.
[The Quintessential Breath of Extremity has come across two Quintessentially compatible concepts.]I think you should take a look at
The beginning and the end. They mixed with each other in a deep sense of Convergence as an instant later...
[A second Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity is taking root within your Soul.]
A milky crimson light shone as Noah's soul felt enormous euphoria, his eyes opening like grand suns as he was about to bellow out in achievement!
But before he could roar out with glory...
THUMP!
His heart banged again as another breath was unconsciously taken.
And the milky crimson light that was the intermixing of Primordiality and Ruination went utterly wild.
It pulled upon multiple other sources of Boundaries at this moment and sucked them towards itself forcefully!
[The Second Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity has released a wave of Quintessential Resonance towards The Sources of Chaos within your Aspects of Existence!]
[The Convergence of the Second Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity rises sharply!]
[Entropy is pulled into the Second Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity.]
[Nullity is pulled into the Second Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity.]
[Ruin is pulled into the Second Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity.]
Something unexpected occurred.
Something that even Noah couldn't have hoped for- nor did he fully understand!

The mixture of beginning and the end resonated with all Sources of Chaos as a terrifying and ancient aura erupted from his body as he breathed once more, those aware to Boundaries within the Infinite Plane feeling a massive weight cascading down their souls.
Orion and Aurelia felt this even more closely as even though their Dynamis of Extremity had achieved full Convergence, they cried out as they felt a deep sense of oppression at this moment!
This was because the Dynamis of Extremity being born didn't have 2 concepts within it.
It held far more than this as when Noah picked up on its resonance with sources of chaos...
He pulled from the Sources of Complete Crimson III Aeonic Pearls of Extremity within his soul as he spoke grandly.
"Add Armageddon into the mix!"
WAA!
"Let Apocalypse mix in as well

Complete Crimson III Aeonic Pearls of Extremity burned as multiple more Boundaries were instantly raised to the 9th Boundary Layer- his job as a Quintessential Aeonic Curator going to work to make them Consummate at the same time!
Their essences bloomed as their addition came to match the 24 number of essences that the First Volume of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity could handle.
And the result...
[Armageddon is pulled into the Second Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity.]
[Apocalypse is pulled into the Second Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity.]
[The Convergence of the Second Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity rises Quintessentially!]
[The Convergence of the Second Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity has reached a critical threshold as it has named itself]
[The Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity has been born.]
[The Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity has exceeded 10% Convergence!]
[The Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity vibrates with Quintessential Instability!]
[Warning! Immediate action is required to correct a Quintessential Instability!]
THUMP!
His heart beat again as this time, a massive crack erupted on his chest similar to to a Plane of Existence shattering as a sea of multicolored stellar blood gushed out!

It held far more than this as when Noah picked up on its resonance with sources of chaos...
He pulled from the Sources of Complete Crimson III Aeonic Pearls of Extremity within his soul as he spoke grandly.
"Add Armageddon into the mix!"
WAA!
"Let Apocalypse mix in as well

Complete Crimson III Aeonic Pearls of Extremity burned as multiple more Boundaries were instantly raised to the 9th Boundary Layer- his job as a Quintessential Aeonic Curator going to work to make them Consummate at the same time!
Their essences bloomed as their addition came to match the 24 number of essences that the First Volume of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity could handle.
And the result...
[Armageddon is pulled into the Second Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity.]
[Apocalypse is pulled into the Second Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity.]
[The Convergence of the Second Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity rises Quintessentially!]
[The Convergence of the Second Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity has reached a critical threshold as it has named itself]
[The Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity has been born.]
[The Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity has exceeded 10% Convergence!]
[The Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity vibrates with Quintessential Instability!]
[Warning!
Immediate action is required to correct a Quintessential Instability!]
THUMP!
His heart beat again as this time, a massive crack erupted on his chest similar to to a Plane of Existence shattering as a sea of multicolored stellar blood gushed out!

chapters.title: Chapter 2418 Indefatigable IV
paragraphs: Shock, followed by a feeling of horror and immense sorrow!
These were the emotions of the Vassals under Noah who were gazing at his blinding visage that was akin to a breathing engine that devoured Essences and spat out even more purified versions.
They were staring at his glory before as an instant later, the situation drastically changed with the blaring of an oppressive aura that was enough to bring them to their knees!
An aura that Aurelia and Orion felt more closely than anyone else as the two of them had forged Dynamis of Extremity.
They could instinctively feel the difference in the Dynamis of Extremit of others compared to their own as they could gauge just how much stronger one was!
Typically, the Convergence of two concepts would not greatly differ in power-one of the factors being whether it was two Golden Consummate Boundaries or two Crimson Consummate Boundaries.

But an even heavier factor...was the number of concepts one converged to bring together a Dynamis of Extremity! Adding two concepts was already something only geniuses were able to do perform as combining three or four concepts? Only the Elders of the Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity being spoiled with drives of Resources and treasures could even dream of such a thing.
So the overwhelming aura that bellowed out from Noah... it entirely caused Genesis to become ashen as he felt his Origin Dynamis of Extremity cower in his soul!
The Dynamis of a lower life form... caused the Dynamis of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform to cower!

Genesis wasn't the only one as Aurelia who was closest to Noah at this junction...her soul trembled as she felt the birth of this terrifying Dynamis of Extremity, her closeness telling her one thing with surety.

That there lay a possibility... of this blooming Dynamis to actually be capable of reaching her! That it may be able to bypass the limitations of lower lifeforms and touch the glorious stage of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!
But before she could feel this oppression for too long...
CRACK!
It was akin to a Plane shattering.
And a multicolored sea of blood gushed out as the broad chest of the man before her split as wild Instability erupted out!
Aurelia faced such a shocking phenomenon as she instantly felt the Instability of the forming Dynamis of Extremity as she felt great sorrow!
Would such a thing actually never be allowed to form? Would it go so far as to even destroy the existence trying to bring it together?!
How could it be so easy?
To bring together multiple concepts of Extremity into a single Dynamis of Extremity...how could this be allowed?
How could such an achievement come by so simply!
More often than not, prodigies who bit off more than they could chew would be destroyed under their own glory as... was this what was going to unfold before her?
"Father!"
"Little Fish!"
"Noah!"
From afar, those closest to Noah had long felt the changes like many others as they had come to watch the unfolding glory, only to see an unfolding disaster.
Yet even while others worried and gazed towards him in astonishment and horror, Noah's Will remained robust and steady even as his Aspects of Existence took a hit.
He had to act quickly, otherwise everything would be lost!
Bringing together all of these concepts under the same conditions may be a possibility, but Noah felt like it would be insurmountable and immensely difficult to do so in the future.
So his mind worked fast as an instant later...I think you should take a look at
[Warning! Immediate rectification is required!]
Cracks continued to spread across his chest and towards his whole body as the very cluster of Essences he was trying to form seemed to be running wild and trying to annihilate him.
At such a juncture, Noah fearlessly breathed in again.
His heart let out another resounding beat as a sea of multicolored stellar blood gushed from him endlessly.
Time slowed under his eyes.
The unbelievably beautiful figure of a worried Aurelia before him.
The figures of his close family and friends in the distance.
Everything faded as his Soul came to focus on nothing other than himself.
He felt the Essences ravaging across his very atoms as it seemed there was...
'Too much chaos...'
WAA!
There was a heavy and firm imbalance towards the Sources of Chaos that the initial mixture of Ruination and Primordiality called in.
This was one problem.
The other...was Noah's Aspects of Existence themselves as they felt like they were trying to contain a raging sea in a body that was akin to a small pond!
What he was doing...was far too advanced for his stage.
His Origin, Body, and Soul felt this strain closely!
But Noah didn't focus on this second issue. He felt that if he could solve the issue of Instability, the latter issue would have a smoother pathway to follow.

And to solve the issue of having too many Sources of Chaos... he had to pull one away and add other ingredients to balance things- because he knew there was a very, very limited number of concepts he could continue to force together to make the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity!
And when he looked at the currently mixing Sources of chaos, he eliminated the thought of removing any of those that stemmed from him.

Anything he made was Quintessential. So his gaze came to Ruin and Nullity as an instant later, he gazed ever close to Ruin. He then gazed at Ruination. Seeing their infinitely close qualities and grandeur with the latter being something entirely his...
BZZT!
[Ruin is pulled out of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity.]
[The Quintessential Instability still persists!]
A single state of chaos was removed as it didn't change the situation drastically. But this was to be expected.
If he removed a Source of Chaos, he then had to add something that could bring order.
His soul released profound waves of radiance as he uttered out.
"Expand the concept of Genesis to the 9th Boundary Layer."
A Source of Complete Crimson III Aeonic Pearl of Extremity burned as Noah enacted his version of Genesis!
Not the concept of Genesis exemplified by the First True Emperor- Orion, but his own distinguished concept of Genesis!
