chapters.title: Chapter 2419 Indefatigable V
paragraphs: Genesis.
Similar to Primordiality, it spoke of beginnings.
What was Noah's true beginning?
When he was born? When his blue planet began its Apocalypse? Or when he used the Rank F Fireball Skill Book and became a Hunter? Or when he sat on the True Throne of Quintessence?
Just what was his true beginning?
As this question arose, so did a blinding white gold light from the depths of his Soul as it already passed through the hands of the Curator to become of the Golden Consummate Tier!
It was his own version of Genesis with its own 9 profound Layers, and it joined the fray at this moment!
[Genesis is pulled into the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity.]
WAA!
The Essences calmed slightly.
They pulsed with glorious synchrony as even with this...it still wasn't enough as his skin and musculature fractured even more!
Yet his eyes still shone like massive lanterns of light as in this slowed time, he made another move.
Since the many concepts of the end and destruction needed to be balanced out...
Since there was a concept that was a huge part to how these concepts achieved their current level...
Since it was a Quintessential Instability...
Noah's will buzzed as he moved decisively, forcing the essence of Quintessence into the fray at this moment!
Quintessence!
All the Boundaries he enacted were Quintessential as this quality was at their very core- and what better concept of stabilization could there be if not this?!
[Quintessence is pulled into the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity.]
The torrential waves of essence ravaging his body calmed down a little bit more as still..there remained a hint of Instability.
His body shone unstably with the Essences of Primordiality, Ruination, Entropy, Nullity, Armageddon, Apocalypse, Genesis, and Quintessence!
8 Essences.
5 were of chaos and destruction. 3 were of beginnings and order.
Noah felt like...he needed one more. He felt like he required one more piece of the puzzle that would grant complete stabilization!
Now, what could he use to bring everything together?
What could work with Quintessence to calm down raging waves of Essences as it would have no trouble mixing with so many different Essences, and may instead only bring them closer?!
A devilish smile bloomed on his bloody face even as more cracks spread throughout his body.
But he wasn't worried.
He was unfettered.
And just like the Dynamis of Extremity he was about to bring to fruition...
He was Indefatigable!
THUMP!
A breath of Quintessence was taken. A resounding heart made a beat. And...
A blue light shone.
Mana flourished.
Infinite Mana!
Glorious and endless waves of mana! Manadynamics surged into the fray.
[Manadynamics is pulled into the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity!]
A blue sea permeated across his very atoms.
It was like a calming surge that came to cool down and wash all things.
This concept that stated power was neither created nor destroyed...it went on to act as the mediator between concepts of the beginning and the end!
BZZZT!
[A Quintessential Resonance of Extremity is washing away all instabilities]
[The two concepts that make up the First Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity are undergoing resonance in the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity.]
[All possibilities of the First Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity are absorbed into the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity!]
The cracks stopped spreading across his body.
THUMP!
His heart beat again as an instant later, all damaged musculature, organs, skin, and bones healed as astounding brilliance erupted all around him!
[An Achievement worthy of being Recorded in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!]
[Against improbable odds, the Convergence of a Dynamis of Extremity made of 9 Concepts of
Extremity has been born.]
[The Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity is stabilizing and has achieved 25% Convergence]
[You have come across One of the Absolute Seeds of Extremity!]
The slowed time felt like it came to a stop.
A milky red coral-colored light erupted from Noah and covered utterly everything as an unfathomable radiance of Extremity spread.
A light that caused the Dynamis of Aurelia and Orion to shudder as they affirmed that when this light was completely converged, it would even be able to reach Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!

But more than anything, the man at the center of it all felt profound and unimaginable changes as at the center of his soul, a massive Rune that constantly ushered forth waves of Extremity was being etched with glory.
The Rune simply read [INDEFATIGABLE] in a few strokes as...
THUMP!
It pulsed with Noah's heartbeat.
WAA!
And it pulsed in conjunction with his breath.
Everything seemed to be in a deep synchrony as endless coral waves of essence surged out from this Rune and spread out across every atom in his body!
[The Essence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity has begun to cycle across your Aspects of Existence with every Quintessential Breath.]
[The Breadth of your Existence is being expanded.]
[Your Body, Origin, and Soul are being expanded and refined under the light of One of the Absolute Seeds of Extremity!]
Torrential waves of mana erupted from the very depths of his being as the second issue in all this...began its resolution!
The breadth of his Existence was forcefully and unimaginably raised as his Second Plane of Extremity expanded rapidly, his Aeonic Soul Values curving upwards exponentially
while his body commenced to release a luster of impenetrability!
This was all due to...Indefatigability!

One of the Absolute Seeds of Extremity! As for what such a distinction meant? Noah wasn't able to delve into it yet as the feeling of his very Existence being expanded caused him to vibrate like a blooming singularity, a bellow erupting from him that released a stellar coral colored light that even escaped the walls of the Infinite Plane to illuminate the barren Planar Palisades of Extremity.
OOOOH!
A bellow that seemed like an ancient primal beast awakening.
A bellow of an existence making a deep achievement!
It was the bellow of the True Emperor of Quintessence after he enacted a Dynamis of Extremity with 9 Concepts of Extremity swirling in harmony!

chapters.title: Chapter 2420 An Absolute Seedof Extremity I
paragraphs: Coral colored.
Magenta.
It could vary depending on the eyes set on it!
The color seemed deeply red at times as an instant later, the milky white turned it into a beautiful coral light that dazzled one's very soul.
Such a dense hue of wonder erupted from Noah and covered the vast Infinite Plane entirely, even blaring out into the Planar Palisades of Extremity as it stretched out across all parts of Noah!
All parts.
His clones.
His Reified Sources of Extremity.
Everything!

In the utterly chaotic domain filled with floating obelisks and Unequaled Aeonic Leviathans of Dissolution- along with a blossoming Extremity Panacea that was radiating less gold and obsidian light as a crimson grandeur Extremity surrounded it!
Many beings were surging towards it even with the massive Leviathans surrounding it, with some regions in particular showing the discrepancy in the power between Unequaled Reverend Emperors.

In one area, a young woman with a dazzling horn on her forehead cut across space like a stellar ruler of light- the sheer heat emanating from her burning the skin of any nearby Reverends as the area around her was entirely empty- and she seemed like a lone sun that was surging towards Extremity!
She was Ayame of the Infinite Extremity.

In another region, a being donning white slippers, loose stellar white shorts, and a blue beach shirt moved across space with his hands freely entrenched in his pockets- his tan skin radiating wonder as his eyes released a calculative and authoritative light as if everything here was captured within them!

A smile lingered on his face as a single step he took...warped space and took him past many beings as at this juncture, he passed by a Scion of an Aeonic Inheritance of Extremity who reacted instinctively to stop the advancement of a competitor- his hand erupting out with over a dozen Consummate Boundaries that weaved into a roaring cluster of Essences smashing towards Erikson.
Yet this being didn't even bat an eye as he only took his right hand out of his pocket.

His beach shirt glimmered with dazzling light as he waved his hand towards the released attack, the roaring flames of Boundaries instantly being snuffed out as if they were never there as the Scion who sent the attack out was instantly filled with immense shock and terror- an invisible pressure seemingly wrapping around him on all sides as his body deformed and folded in itself- akin to a tomato being crushed in one's hands an instant later, all he was was a mass of blood and bones!
Erikson didn't even look back as he continued, those near him seeing this scene and moving away from this region as some even whispered in the distance!
"It is Master Erikson..."
"The Immovable Reverend!"
His name and distinction carried fear as this was a sense of discrepancy between Reverends as some were leagues apart from others.
Each of them were filled with pride and power.
But at this moment...their gazes changed.
Shock overcame them.
This was because in a certain direction, there was the visage of an existence whose very body seemed to be made of stellar Realities and Cosmos.
It was the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity that at this moment began to radiate a coral colored light!
This light caused the gazes of shock as the souls of nearly all Reverends shuddered fearfully.
And the souls of all others felt a strain as in one direction, Ayame turned towards this radiating light in shock!
In another direction, Erikson stopped as his massive figure turned around- his eyes showing genuine shock as an moment later, a wild smile bloomed on his face as he changed direction.
He no longer went towards the blossoming Extremity Panacea!

He barreled forth as if he was a volatile singularity, his hands coming out of his pockets as with an imposing demeanor- everyone on his path was smashed away like a cannonball with the wind knocked out of them!
His path was straight as veered towards the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity shining with bright coral grandeur, coming to float opposite him as a sense of wildness and freedom emanated from him.

Not too long after, powerful auras of Unequaled Reverend Emperors donned in neat suits appeared behind him, a woman in a tight fitting suit pushing up the rims of her glasses as she hid the shock in her eyes while asking lightly.
"What are we doing, Master Erikson?"

Their bodies buzzed with a profound sense of grandeur as over a dozen Boundary Essences swirled with purpose and intent- a unique Extremity Circulation Modus Operandi being operated by them as they were ready to follow this being in whatever action he wanted to take.
The shining stellar visage of the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity also gazed towards him coldly as his stare glanced past him towards the shining Extremity Panacea in the distance.
As if seeing this gaze, Erikson smiled as he waved his hands freely.
"Nobody here will be able to obtain the First Extremity Panacea easily. There's the Leviathans of Dissolution to tire out and kill along with something extra...so we can afford a few minutes."
He held a wild charm and handsomeness while he spoke, his massive figure in comparison to others making him seem like a titan as he continued to speak at this moment.

"Let me be the first to congratulate you on such a deep achievement. You don't come across too many Apex Aeonic Lifeforms who can form an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, much less someone who hasn't even undergone Apexification."
WAA!
His words caused the powerful Scions adorned in suits behind him to settle calmly as the battle intent they had faded after they heard Master Erikson's words.
But what he uttered next caused them to gape in shock as this being said something that caused the very surroundings to tremble!
"Friend, I stand before you today representing the Sima Clan in extending an invitation."
BOOM!
"Master Erikson!"
"Sir!"
His words caused an eruption of a deep sense of Extremity just from being uttered.
This was especially so for the words [Sima]!
The Sima Clan!

It could vary depending on the eyes set on it!
The color seemed deeply red at times as an instant later, the milky white turned it into a beautiful coral light that dazzled one's very soul.
Such a dense hue of wonder erupted from Noah and covered the vast Infinite Plane entirely, even blaring out into the Planar Palisades of Extremity as it stretched out across all parts of Noah!
All parts.
His clones.
His Reified Sources of Extremity.
Everything!

In the utterly chaotic domain filled with floating obelisks and Unequaled Aeonic Leviathans of Dissolution- along with a blossoming Extremity Panacea that was radiating less gold and obsidian light as a crimson grandeur Extremity surrounded it!
Many beings were surging towards it even with the massive Leviathans surrounding it, with some regions in particular showing the discrepancy in the power between Unequaled Reverend Emperors.

In one area, a young woman with a dazzling horn on her forehead cut across space like a stellar ruler of light- the sheer heat emanating from her burning the skin of any nearby Reverends as the area around her was entirely empty- and she seemed like a lone sun that was surging towards Extremity!
She was Ayame of the Infinite Extremity.

In another region, a being donning white slippers, loose stellar white shorts, and a blue beach shirt moved across space with his hands freely entrenched in his pockets- his tan skin radiating wonder as his eyes released a calculative and authoritative light as if everything here was captured within them!

A smile lingered on his face as a single step he took...warped space and took him past many beings as at this juncture, he passed by a Scion of an Aeonic Inheritance of Extremity who reacted instinctively to stop the advancement of a competitor- his hand erupting out with over a dozen Consummate Boundaries that weaved into a roaring cluster of Essences smashing towards Erikson.
Yet this being didn't even bat an eye as he only took his right hand out of his pocket.

His beach shirt glimmered with dazzling light as he waved his hand towards the released attack, the roaring flames of Boundaries instantly being snuffed out as if they were never there as the Scion who sent the attack out was instantly filled with immense shock and terror- an invisible pressure seemingly wrapping around him on all sides as his body deformed and folded in itself- akin to a tomato being crushed in one's hands an instant later, all he was was a mass of blood and bones!
Erikson didn't even look back as he continued, those near him seeing this scene and moving away from this region as some even whispered in the distance!
"It is Master Erikson..."
"The Immovable Reverend!"
His name and distinction carried fear as this was a sense of discrepancy between Reverends as some were leagues apart from others.
Each of them were filled with pride and power.
But at this moment...their gazes changed.
Shock overcame them.
This was because in a certain direction, there was the visage of an existence whose very body seemed to be made of stellar Realities and Cosmos.
It was the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity that at this moment began to radiate a coral colored light!
This light caused the gazes of shock as the souls of nearly all Reverends shuddered fearfully.
And the souls of all others felt a strain as in one direction, Ayame turned towards this radiating light in shock!
In another direction, Erikson stopped as his massive figure turned around- his eyes showing genuine shock as an moment later, a wild smile bloomed on his face as he changed direction.
He no longer went towards the blossoming Extremity Panacea!

He barreled forth as if he was a volatile singularity, his hands coming out of his pockets as with an imposing demeanor- everyone on his path was smashed away like a cannonball with the wind knocked out of them!
His path was straight as veered towards the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity shining with bright coral grandeur, coming to float opposite him as a sense of wildness and freedom emanated from him.

Not too long after, powerful auras of Unequaled Reverend Emperors donned in neat suits appeared behind him, a woman in a tight fitting suit pushing up the rims of her glasses as she hid the shock in her eyes while asking lightly.
"What are we doing, Master Erikson?"

Their bodies buzzed with a profound sense of grandeur as over a dozen Boundary Essences swirled with purpose and intent- a unique Extremity Circulation Modus Operandi being operated by them as they were ready to follow this being in whatever action he wanted to take.
The shining stellar visage of the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity also gazed towards him coldly as his stare glanced past him towards the shining Extremity Panacea in the distance.
As if seeing this gaze, Erikson smiled as he waved his hands freely.
"Nobody here will be able to obtain the First Extremity Panacea easily.
There's the Leviathans of Dissolution to tire out and kill along with something extra...so we can afford a few minutes."
He held a wild charm and handsomeness while he spoke, his massive figure in comparison to others making him seem like a titan as he continued to speak at this moment.
"Let me be the first to congratulate you on such a deep achievement.
You don't come across too many Apex Aeonic Lifeforms who can form an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, much less someone who hasn't even undergone Apexification."
WAA!
His words caused the powerful Scions adorned in suits behind him to settle calmly as the battle intent they had faded after they heard Master Erikson's words.
But what he uttered next caused them to gape in shock as this being said something that caused the very surroundings to tremble!
"Friend, I stand before you today representing the Sima Clan in extending an invitation."
BOOM!
"Master Erikson!"
"Sir!"
His words caused an eruption of a deep sense of Extremity just from being uttered.
This was especially so for the words [Sima]!
The Sima Clan!

chapters.title: Chapter 2421 An Absolute Seedof Extremity II
paragraphs: The Sima Clan!

It didn't have any grandiose name like Infinite Extremity or Genesis Institute of Extremity, and it stood alone and imposing in its power and nature as this was a Behemoth that stood above most Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity.
There were too many Inheritances across the Seven Aeonic Havens.
But there were a limited number of Inheritances that were Known as Clans.
And for those in the surroundings who heard the words uttered by Erikson, they couldn't help but recoil in shock and wonder as some knew an unbroken truth about this behemoth!
"The Sima Clan has only ever had direct Bloodline Descendants take their name. Do you really have the authority to represent the Sima Clan in breaking one of its oldest rules?"
A crimson horn shone as Ayame of the Infinite Extremity appeared to the left, her gaze shining with perplexing emotions as she voiced out towards Erikson while focusing on Noah's astounding visage.
Erikson's magnetic figure didn't even turn as his gaze remained straight, remaining on Noah as he continued.
"If I say I have the authority to represent, then I have the authority to represent. The Inheritance of the Infinite Extremity has no power to fight me on this."
WAA!
His demeanor was carefree and wild.

His Will was dominating as he looked towards Noah, the first thought on his mind being to extend an olive branch and invite this being into the folds of one of the most powerful hegemonies within the Seven Aeonic Havens!
And all of this was brought about by the grandeur of a dazzling coral light.
And as soon as the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity radiated this

coral light, 8 other Sources of Extremity in the far distance who were standing before the combined forces of a few hundred Scions of Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity also released the same dazzling grandeur.
The Harbinger of Entropy- Bellicus, was at the very forefront as this radiating light caused Phos and all other Scions who had chosen to join him to instantly turn grim!
Their bodies instantly blared with the light of Apex Aeonic Soul Totems, but even with this- their hearts didn't feel at ease as it seemed like it may not be enough.
This was just within the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands that had a layer of the Extremity Vein of Dissolution beginning to show.
Far away from this.
Away from glacial layers of Nullity covering the Abyss.
In the regions that held the Lernaean Domains.
The flourishing of the coral colored light bloomed from 9 different directions as it represented the 9 Dimensional Chassis currently moving to devour the Lernaean Domains!
When this light flashed, the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms in this region of the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution turned towards these different directions in shock.

And even further away from this region, in the Lands of the Noblesse, Quasarians, and Planeswalkers- the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms in these regions all also felt a hint of this radiating coral light as when it shone, it briefly rose to the skies above the 9 different points of light and caused a cloud of brilliant Extremity to flourish.
As if the very Havens of Dissolution were commending this action that was being recorded in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!
Dissolution.

In a region where no Apex Aeonic Lifeforms could reach, an existence with the title of Dissolution turned her head away from the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands where she observed a similar coral light, turning towards the 9 points of brightness right now as she gazed towards blossoming coral lights within this region of the Haven she monitored.
Her gaze and face were veiled as usual, but one could sense genuine surprise and appreciation from it!
"The grandeur of an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity? From a lifeform that hasn't even undergone Apexification?"
An Absolute Dynamis of Extremity!
Its distinction had to be like so as this was a hidden condition very few beings knew the true standing of.
If one was ever able to pull together a sufficient number of concepts and Converge them to form an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, then they had just opened one of the pathways to Extremity.

They had attained one of the Absolute Seeds of Extremity as it would accompany them in their Existence, with the absolute promise that so long as they didn't die, with enough time... they would achieve Extremity!
Extremity was an uncertainty with all beings, but those who had attained an Absolute Seed of Extremity only had the factor of time.
It meant that the being releasing this grand light of glory was guaranteed to reach Extremity in his lifetime!
But this wasn't all.
There was something that the Adjudicator of Dissolution held with much more importance when it came to Absolute Seeds of Extremity blooming within existences.
It meant...
"He has a nearly guaranteed chance to attain that..."
That.
She didn't state clearly what it was, but it was the decider between life and death.
It was something that Apex Aeonic Lifeforms or even those who had reached Extremity couldn't seek as they either had it, or they didn't!
Those who had it were the bastions and pillars of Extremity, and entities like her- an Adjudicator of a Haven... were in their positions to monitor things just like this.
To monitor the Extremity Sanctification and workings of Havens as they were here to rectify and
optimize the errors of previous Sanctifications in the first 6 Havens!
To ensure that the greatest possible number of beings reached the level of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform and for as many as possible to attain Extremity.
And the current situation fell in line with her duties.
She wanted to convey with this being right away to ready him for what was to come, but it wasn't entirely following procedure if she did so, so she would instead monitor.
When the time came where he reached Apexification, he would come to know!
BZZZT!
Arcs of light erupted around the barely discernible figure of the Adjudicator of Dissolution as around her, illusory screens of light showing some of the moving Dimensional Chassis and even
Reified Sources of Extremity- a particularly dominant being paying a closer look at the True Emperor of Quintessence as he appeared in her radar!

chapters.title: Chapter 2422 An Absolute Seedof Extremity III
paragraphs: Wrapped in Shadows, Grand Primeval Silas was instantly awoken as he stared towards 9 different directions blaring with glorious light.
An instant later, his figure shot out towards it as the feeling from his soul when it felt this light...it forced him to seek to understand the Source it came from!
He wasn't the only one as Apex Aeonic Lifeforms in this region all scrambled to see what the source was.
Even further, those in the Domains of Noblesse, Quasarians, and Planeswalkers also moved towards the o blinding points of light as they had to affirm something!
This was the wildness caused by the advent of the Absolute Dynamis of Extremity- the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity!
So what boons did it provide the being who had actually forged it?
[The Essence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity is cycling across your Aspects of Existence with every Quintessential Breath, forever altering your Aspects Of Existence]
[Your Foundation is proceeding towards your own unique type of Extremity Foundation with every cycle of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity.]
[Your Second Plane of Extremity is devouring the grandeur of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity and expanding the 9 Major Dimensions.]
Such were the prompts passing over Noah's eyes as his main body cascaded with coral waves of light that enriched everything within the Infinite Plane in unfathomable ways.
He seemed like a radiant sun that others could stare at for too long as right in front of him, the figure of Aurelia gazed at his figure with utmost incredulity.
"You actually...succeeded?"

Her throat felt dry as she spoke, the visage of Orion also appearing near this region along with Dimensional Rulers, Noah's closest companions, and a few other prominent Vassals who could barely handle the pressing pressure.
He succeeded in something that actually caused Apex Aeonic Lifeforms to feel a sense of threat as what did this mean?
If he truly developed this Dynamis of Extremity to full convergence, would he actually be able to stand against Apex Aeonic Lifeforms?
The idea alone was enough to drive one mad as even in the wake of such a grand accomplishment, Noah couldn't share it joyfully as its boons were only continuing to open before his eyes!
[The Authority of Aeonic Anti-Mana is now possible through the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity.]
Aeonic Anti-Mana!

A feature that was only just mentioned when the First Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity between Mana and Nullity formed, and it would have been accessible to Noah at 100% complete Convergence of that Dynamis!

Now that both Mana and Nullity were absorbed into the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity that entirely ate up the workings of the First Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity, this Authority was shockingly received before the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity was even fully converged.
Only at 25% Convergence, and it already granted the same authority as a Dynamis with the mixture of 2 Concepts of Extremity
But this wasn't all.
The prompts continued to come.
[The Authority of Aeonic Mana Drain is now possible through the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity.]
[The path you walk on is unfathomable as it was able to produce the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity, and it therefore cannot and should not be changed.]

[The path of others is predictable and mundane, and you can therefore manipulate its beginning and its end. Through the use of the essence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity, the Feature of Realm Reconstruction is born]
Anti-Mana, Mana Drain, and Realm Reconstruction!
Realm Reconstruction!
Noah's eyes opened at such a grand proclamation as he put all other notifications on standby while focusing on this.

[Realm Reconstruction]:: An Ability brought to light through the essence of the Absolute Seed of Extremity- the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity. The essence of this Dynamis allows for you to bring an conclusion to the Realm of existences and offer them a new beginning- one that can be manipulated through your hands as you can extrapolate new stages of power or construct a route similar to what you followed. Nobody else will be able to replicate the Realm and path you are following, but a Lesser Realm Pathway of Quintessence can be chosen as the template for your targets to follow through your hands. You can reconstruct the Realm of Existences from beginning to the end that is only limited by your own equivalent stage of power, with your Convergence in the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity increasing the more beginnings and ends you experience with your own hands, along with your understanding of all concepts related to Extremity. The source of power for the Realm Reconstruction will be purely supplied by the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity as existences with reforged Realms will be on the path to attain a Lesser Indefatigable Foundation of Extremity or other Extremity Foundations depending on how you construct their Realm. Experience the beginning and the end, experience Extremity!

A grandiose feature that allowed Noah to do ridiculous things with the essence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity- something that wasn't directly affecting him, but through it... he would take even closer steps towards Extremity as he would experience the beginnings and ends of as many creatures as he performed it on.
This...was just one of the benefits of this Absolute Seed of Extremity!

What was the purpose of the Initiation Step of the Extremity Vein of Dissolution? All Reverends were fighting to achieve Extremity Panaceas that would grant them a profound Extremity Foundation that would aid them in smoothly undergoing Apexification!
Yet Noah's Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity...could restructure Realms as just one of its features, with the conclusion result being an Extremity Foundation.
What a magnificent Dynamis!
Truly an Absolute Seed of Extremity!

Seeing this ridiculous feature, Noah's heart couldn't sit still as while his body pulsed with the coral allure of grandeur, his eyes opened to gaze at the worried looks around him as he released a smile that caused all anxious expressions to fade.
He was gazing at all of them as he wanted to test out this feature right away, and for this...he needed the first test subject!

chapters.title: Chapter 2423 An Absolute Seedof Extremity IV
paragraphs: As the anxiety caused by the prior situation faded from their eyes, Noah looked through the masses around him as his eyes passed over Adelaide and Henry, past Barbatos and Kazuhiko, past Eowyn and the Dimensional Rulers...it passed over many beings as they came to stop on the First Spiritual Beast- the Emperor Penguin!

The golden eyes of this creature that pulsed with Providence shone as similar to the Reified Enders of Nature that were connected to the will of the Past Barren Lands that was now assimilated to the Infinite Plane, it was a Creature that was closely connected to the past Spiritual Land that the whole of Infinite Plane stemmed from.
It enjoyed similar boons as its Source could now be stirred with the Sources of the Natural Laws as it was painted gold with Providence.
Noah beckoned to this Spiritual Beast as it blinked and pointed its right flipper to itself, a nod of affirmation coming from Noah as the Emperor Penguin instantly turned into a streak
of light!
RAA!
With a glorious bellow, it appeared before Noah as its sleek fur released boundless luster and glory.
Noah looked at the Emperor Penguin alone as the shocked gazes of Aurelia, Orion, or any other beings were utterly ignored.
"Do you trust me?"
He spoke simply to the being bound to him before his eyes.
And the Emperor Penguin didn't even miss a beat as his golden beak nodded vehemently!
Noah's smile was brilliant at such a scene as he waved his hands and uttered out.
[Realm Reconstruction].
BZZT!

The pristine coral light of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity moved out like an endless time from Noah, merging around the Emperor Penguin as the body of this existence became crystalline, its Origin becoming apparent under Noah's eyes as the built up Origin of an Apocryphal Planar Haven made up of clusters of Grotto Havens...was caused to crumble in the next instant as gasps rang out in the surroundings.

The body of the Emperor Penguin had become crystalline as its Origin was clear, and everyone was able to see its Realm that some took millions or billions of years to forge...was utterly destroyed and taken away in an instant!
The Origin of the Emperor Penguin was ground down to nothing and brought to an end.
Under the astonished and shocked gazes of all beings, Noah felt the vibrant essence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity leak from him and cradle the body of the Emperor Penguin.
No Instability occurred within its Aspects of Existence even though the soul and body seemed to lose a crucial part as they also became extremely weak!

And the essence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity that held Ruination, Apocalypse, and other concepts that could smoothly bring about an end became even stronger as the Realm of the Emperor Penguin was reversed to be so thin that one could barely sense its aura!
Its halcyon grandeur faded as its sleek fur seemed to lose light.

Its aura decayed to the extent that it became the weakest being in all of the Infinite Plane...holding a Rank never before seen due to just how powerful the atmospheric essence across the Infinite Plane was.
The Emperor Penguin emanated weak waves Of life at Rank F.
It was an astonishing scene to observe as an moment later...
THUMP!
Akin to the beating of a heart, the core of the Emperor Penguin lit up brightly as its Origin began to be reconstructed.

The same essence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity that had destroyed everything it held now turned to express astonishing life force and an aura of beginning as the enacted core very quickly increased in concentration- Noah becoming entirely focused at this moment as he experienced the end, and he was now watching and even directing a new beginning!
A new Realm!
'At its core...let us have the essence of Primordiality.'

He began his experimentations as an abundant Life force erupted, the aura the Emperor Penguin expressed very quickly jumping from Rank F all the way to Rank S, and then instantly jumping across the stages of Epic, Legendary, Mythical, Phantasmal, Transcendent, Saint, Void, and Soul as its body became covered by a gorgeous milky white light!

A light of profundity shone with his eyes as he observed the beginning of this pathway.
[Under the Influence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity, you are observing a cycle of an end and a beginning. Your Convergence of this Dynamis increases slightly.]

Within the core of the Emperor Penguin, a Domain formed as it was filled with an overabundance of Primordiality.

When this process arrived, one could see the body and soul that housed this core begin to break down and change as an air of profound ancientness began to emanate from the weak body of the Emperor Penguin!
And from the constructed Domain...a World formed as the World Realm was reached in but an instant.

This World was then compressed and condensed into a star as the Emperor Penguin reached the Star Forging Realm, and not too long after...this star underwent controlled destruction and turned into countless dots of dust that formed into a Nebula!
A Nebula filled with dazzling miniature stars as vast as the grains of sand- and it still shone with abundant Primordiality!

Thereafter, Nebulae condensed to form supermassive black holes that then bloomed into Quasars- innumerable numbers of such stellar bodies coming into the picture as in no time... a dazzling milky white Galaxy formed.
RAA!
The Emperor Penguin roared out as his body and soul underwent fundamental changes while his Origin became something of an entirely different composition compared to before!

And from a single galaxy, countless more bloomed as a Galactic Filament was born, 100 Billion Galaxies quickly becoming exceeded until 1,000 Billion were reached. Noah's eyes released gorgeous grandeur as he watched all of these galaxies shine to form a Universal Seed that in the next instant...bloomed into a Universe.

And then like a chain reaction that was under his very fingertips, Noah watched this dazzling Origin go from a single Universe to a Universal Filament with a myriad of dazzling Universes...and these billions of Universes finally came together to form a single Cosmos.

The essence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity nudged the process forward as Noah felt 25% of his total Aeonic Soul Values already be used up, watching as a single Cosmos became multiple and multiplied madly until they reached the critical point where normally, a Reality would form!
But...Noah didn't let the Cosmos fall under a Reality.
His eyes were bright as he spoke out.
"Let the Cosmos be contained in a Plane...just one of the 9 future Planes."

He held 9 Dimensions when he was rising up as this was his uniqueness. Nobody else could replicate what he did as even this restructuring he was doing right now...the Realm he would produce here would be lesser than his grand Origin!

Even more Cosmos multiplied within the Origin of the Emperor Penguin as a thin Planar light wrapped around it, Noah's eyes shining as endless waves of the essence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity surged out from him like an endless sea.
"The First Plane will take the nature of Gravitation...with the other 8 Planes corresponding to the other 8 Natural Laws. This shall be the basis of his Origin!"
WAA!
9 Planes based on the workings of the 9 Natural Laws!

As soon as Noah laid this out, the essence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity erupted out madly and surged into the Origin of the Emperor Penguin to make this a reality, 9 interconnected circular rings forming around each other while countless Cosmos bloomed within them!
The Natural Laws were Natural Laws, but they were also expanded as Boundaries.

Within the Origin of the Emperor Penguin, the intense essence of concepts of Extremity bloomed as its body and soul burned with astonishing brilliance, a prompt rising before Noah's eyes at such a point as he came across his first achievement in Realm Reconstruction!
[You have opened the path of the Nine Natures Extremity Foundation]
Less than a minute had passed since he began the process of Realm Restructuring.

60% of his current Aeonic Soul Values were used up in order to provide the required potency of essence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity, but at the end of the process...he actually ended up opening a type of Extremity Foundation that should be the first of its kind in the Seven Aeonic Havens!

chapters.title: Chapter 2424 An Absolute Seed Of Extremity! V
paragraphs: For Apexification, others sought to build a stupendous foundation that would enable them to smoothly become Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and not fail their advancement at such a juncture.

One of the more immaculate means to obtain a strong base lay in the procurement of Extremity Panaceas with the Initiation Step of Extremity Sanctification, such treasures allowing one to forge a type of Extremity Foundation as they only appeared as exclusivities across the Havens thereafter!

Yet Noah...he managed to forge a type of Extremity Foundation that should be the first of its kind in the Seven Aeonic Havens in less than a minute with his own efforts and capabilities that were only made possible by the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity.
RAA!
The Emperor Penguin roared out madly as droves of intense power coursed through it.
The Nine Natures Extremity Foundation!

This was the path that this being now walked on as his Origin held 9 rotating Planes of Existence that were each filled with the workings of the 9 Natural Laws of Reality that shone with a light of Extremity!

Among those watching this scene in shock, Orion and Aurelia understood intricacies more than most due to their domain as seeing the hint of Extremity blocking within this being's Origin after he was reduced to a state of nothing just seconds ago... they couldn't hide the shock in their eyes at the method that made it possible.
At the means of this being before them!
He had called out Realm Reconstruction before as he did so as was this the extent of what he could do?!
The answer was a resounding no.
BZZT!

The raging power within the body of the Emperor Penguin continued to torrential swirl as its flippers shone with crystalline black and gold grandeur, a multicolored stripe of 9 colors appeared behind its wide back and extended onto a halcyon beak!
It looked with immense fervor towards Noah who thrust his hand forward and continued to release the essence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity.
This was because of a particular passage in the description of [Realm Reconstruction].

[...You can reconstruct the Realm of Existences from beginning to the end that is only limited by your own equivalent stage of power, with your Convergence in the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity increasing the more beginnings and ends your experience with your own hands...]
It was only limited to his own equivalent stage of power.

This was how far he could take their cycles of beginning and end as even though it cost Noah greatly with over 60% of his total Aeonic Soul Values being utilized over half of this had already recovered in the past few seconds as his own Aspects of Existence were experiencing changes brought about from 2 fronts.
One was the essence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity, and the other was every Breath he took from the Quintessential Breath of Extremity!
Since he had the means, he continued.
Trillions of Cosmos continued to bloom within the Origin of the Emperor Penguin as his Body and Soul reacted to these changes and became ever more exemplary!
The Essence of the 9 Boundaries of the past Natural Laws surged like tendrils of lightning on his very skin as in no time...
[The Nine Natures Extremity Foundation has been established in the First Spiritual Beast.]

[When all of the 9 Natures correlating to its Origin reach the 9th Boundary Layer and the 9 Planes of Nature reach complete saturation, the First Spiritual Beast can undergo Apexification with a 100% chance of raising to become an Apex Aeonic Lifeform with a Nine Natures Meridian Apex Aeonic Foundation. With such a foundation, the extrapolation of Dynamis of Extremity connected to the Nine Natures will be possible with relative ease, and if the Will of the Emperor Penguin carries even a trace of the Quintessence of its Master- it can try to bring together all Nine Natures to form an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity.]
This information flourished in Noah's mind.
The Emperor Penguin also understood as it couldn't help but exclaim!

Noah had the pathway to the Nine Natures Extremity Foundation opened before, but he continued further and established it entirely as the moment the Emperor Penguin's Origin reached full saturation along with the Nine Boundaries reaching the 9th Boundary Layer, it could begin his raising its level towards that of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform!
This wasn't to mention the fact that a pathway for a Second Absolute Dynamis of Extremity was shown!

This was something for Noah to also put together, but just the formation of a single Absolute Dynamis of Extremity had already taken up every space within his Soul as his 'Breadth' wasn't even sufficient for it before and was one of the reasons for the Quintessential Instability.

His Aspects of Existence were being stretched out and strengthened now to handle the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity that hadn't even reached 100% Convergence as it would only get more powerful, and after it was fully established with Noah's Aspects of Existence being elevated to even greater heights...he should be able to form another Absolute Dynamis of Extremity!
BZZZT!

Arcs of grandeur buzzed around the Emperor Penguin as from afar, the Wills of the Reverend Emperors from the Lernaean Lineage finally arrived in this area to also observe this grand occasion as their souls stirred.
When they watched the figure of the Emperor Penguin, they felt great pressure as among Reverend Emperors, it could truly be considered Unequaled!

Its power exceeded beings like Rosalind from the Cult of Endless Shadows as the pressure emanating from the Emperor Penguin was akin to some of the more powerful Scions of the ancient Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity.

When the strength of its soul reached greater heights and its proficiency in Boundaries increased...it would no doubt exceed even these Scions as it had already created its Extremity Foundation and simply waited for its completion and saturation!
"Do you know what to do?"
Noah's voice was resonant as he spoke, the Emperor Penguin nodding its beak as dazzling Crimson III Aeonic Pearls of Extremity flowed towards it.
"Yes, Master!"

A radiant stripe of nine colors radiated grandeur on its back as it rose and connected to its beak, the First Spiritual Beast becoming one of the most powerful combatants in the Infinite Plane in an instant after this Realm Reconstruction!

chapters.title: Chapter 2425 An Absolute Seed Of Extremity! VI
paragraphs: Through the single Realm Reconstruction he utilized on the Emperor Penguin, Noah increased his rate of Convergence in the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity while also opening a pathway for a second Absolute Dynamis of Extremity in the future.

This was the boon of Realm Reconstruction as even though he would not and should not alter his own Realm, altering the Realms of others and experiencing cycles of beginnings and ends aided him greatly towards his own path!

It meant many more experimentations were in order as when he rebuilt Origins, he could test different Essences and structures to act as the base as what if instead of 9 Planes correlating to the Natural Laws, what if he restructured an Origin to be made of Planes correlating to the 6 Fundamental Natural Laws? Or even combinations of different concepts of Extremity?
He could establish multiple Extremity Foundations and even gain possible epiphanies into forming more Absolute Dynamis of Extremity as the possibilities were endless!
"Let's see..."

Around the beings gathered here gazing towards him, Noah's Will swept out again even as the vast majority continued to stare in shock, with the figure of Aurelia recovering first as her voice echoed out.
"You can't just do that without explaining anything...how many concepts did you converge to make a Dynamis that terrifying? Hey, Hey!"
She spoke freely as Noah didn't answer her, his eyes having caught onto a figure that caused his eyes to light up with interest as he was an interesting test subject!
SHAA!
His hand beckoned forward as from the back of the hundreds of prominent beings gathered here, the Soul Clone of the being that had been managing the quintillions of Lernaeans was pushed forward.
His body came to the spotlight as his eyes kept in their somberness and shock, the past Interim Aeonic Lernaean Lineage Emperor appearing as it was Maximilian!
A being that had failed Apexification.
A being who was forever closed off to the grandeur of Extremity.
"You wouldn't..." Orion's voice came out in utter disbelief and shock as he and Aurelia were the first to catch on to what Noah was trying to do.

And Noah himself...he pulled upon the Fealty that Maximilian had sworn before he devoured the Abecedarian Sacrarium as he exerting pressure on the Aeonic Soul before him, pulling its main body that was traveling with the main bodies of Orion, Aurelia, and Lucia among others since they left the Lernaean Domain!
BZZT!

A spatial vortex formed as he easily pulled the main body out through the connection with its Soul- causing it to appear in the Infinite Plane right before his eyes as an instant later...his finger tapped out again.
A coral colored light shone.

It blazed around Noah's figure like burning flames of utter regality as while adorned in his Emperor's Robes, he seemed like an ancient celestial that was picking and choosing minor existences to experiment on for his own purposes!
The tap of his finger released a vibrant light of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity that came to focus on the main body of Maximilian as it invaded his Origin, and a moment later...
CRACK!

The Apocryphal Planar Haven he had shattered. The twisted and fractured Meridians he had tried to enact during a failed Apexification...they also destroyed as his Realm began to experience an apocalypse and deteriorate!
All the way...to a barely discernible whisper of life force at Rank F.
The scene was incredulous as even the Aeonic Souls of the 2 Apex Aeonic Lifeforms here had no more words.
Because thereafter, a scene that had just occurred began to repeat again as an Origin reformed and began to rise across the stages of power.
"Genesis shall be the base of the initial Origin...and you shall also have the Nine Natures Extremity Foundation."
WAA!
He made this process go extremely quickly as he didn't try too different of a recipe for this, with his goal affirming something utterly disastrous.
The reality that he ended the Origin of an existence that had failed Apexification.
An existence that was denied Extremity!
And thereafter, he began their Origin anew and even set them on a path of an Extremity Foundation as when Maximilian sought Apexification again...he would have a 100% chance of success!
He...was reversing the very workings of Extremity and the consequences of failed ascensions!

It was so shocking that the being this was all centered around had tears form in his eyes when he felt his reconstructed Origin, tears that formed into stellar rivers as he gazed towards the True Emperor of Quintessence doing all this with utmost reverence that he didn't even look towards Orion or Aurelia with.
And when the Origin of Maximilian formed 9 Planes and the route of a Nine Natures Extremity Foundation opened for him...
HOONG!
Wild waves of Extremity erupted around Noah's visage as notifications rose in waves.
[You have succeeded in doing the impossible!]
[Under the Influence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity, you overcame the reality of an Existence that reached their Absolute End.]
An existence that had reached their Absolute End! One who could never even have the hope of achieving Extremity in their lifetime!
Noah reversed such a reality through nothing other than the Absolute Dynamis of Extremity
The thing considered an Absolute Seed of Extremity- the Indefatigable Dynamis!

[You have reversed an Absolute End and gone further to open up a new beginning that guarantees the targeted existence exceeding their prior accomplishments. Your Convergence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity increases greatly.]
[Your achievements are being Recorded in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.]
[Your Authority as a Quintessential Aeonic Curator has Quintessentially risen.]
His achievements continued to climb as it became abundantly clear...this stage of combining concepts of Extremity held too much in store.
The abilities and potential alone held glorious hints of Extremity itself.
And all this...merely stemmed from a lesser than half formed Absolute Seed of Extremity.
What would Noah be capable of doing when this seed flourished?
What would happen when he actually achieved Extremity?!
The answer was disastrous enough to make his name feared across the Seven Aeonic Havens in the very near future!

Around the beings gathered here gazing towards him, Noah's Will swept out again even as the vast majority continued to stare in shock, with the figure of Aurelia recovering first as her voice echoed out.
"You can't just do that without explaining anything...how many concepts did you converge to make a Dynamis that terrifying?
Hey, Hey!"
She spoke freely as Noah didn't answer her, his eyes having caught onto a figure that caused his eyes to light up with interest as he was an interesting test subject!
SHAA!
His hand beckoned forward as from the back of the hundreds of prominent beings gathered here, the Soul Clone of the being that had been managing the quintillions of Lernaeans was pushed forward.
His body came to the spotlight as his eyes kept in their somberness and shock, the past Interim Aeonic Lernaean Lineage Emperor appearing as it was Maximilian!
A being that had failed Apexification.
A being who was forever closed off to the grandeur of Extremity.
"You wouldn't..." Orion's voice came out in utter disbelief and shock as he and Aurelia were the first to catch on to what Noah was trying to do.

And Noah himself...he pulled upon the Fealty that Maximilian had sworn before he devoured the Abecedarian Sacrarium as he exerting pressure on the Aeonic Soul before him, pulling its main body that was traveling with the main bodies of Orion, Aurelia, and Lucia among others since they left the Lernaean Domain!
BZZT!

A spatial vortex formed as he easily pulled the main body out through the connection with its Soul- causing it to appear in the Infinite Plane right before his eyes as an instant later...his finger tapped out again.
A coral colored light shone.

It blazed around Noah's figure like burning flames of utter regality as while adorned in his Emperor's Robes, he seemed like an ancient celestial that was picking and choosing minor existences to experiment on for his own purposes!
The tap of his finger released a vibrant light of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity that came to focus on the main body of Maximilian as it invaded his Origin, and a moment later...
CRACK!
The Apocryphal Planar Haven he had shattered.
The twisted and fractured Meridians he had tried to enact during a failed Apexification...they also destroyed as his Realm began to experience an apocalypse and deteriorate!
All the way...to a barely discernible whisper of life force at Rank F.
The scene was incredulous as even the Aeonic Souls of the 2 Apex Aeonic Lifeforms here had no more words.
Because thereafter, a scene that had just occurred began to repeat again as an Origin reformed and began to rise across the stages of power.
"Genesis shall be the base of the initial Origin...and you shall also have the Nine Natures Extremity Foundation."
WAA!
He made this process go extremely quickly as he didn't try too different of a recipe for this, with his goal affirming something utterly disastrous.
The reality that he ended the Origin of an existence that had failed Apexification.
An existence that was denied Extremity!
And thereafter, he began their Origin anew and even set them on a path of an Extremity Foundation as when Maximilian sought Apexification again...he would have a 100% chance of success!
He...was reversing the very workings of Extremity and the consequences of failed ascensions!

It was so shocking that the being this was all centered around had tears form in his eyes when he felt his reconstructed Origin, tears that formed into stellar rivers as he gazed towards the True Emperor of Quintessence doing all this with utmost reverence that he didn't even look towards Orion or Aurelia with.
And when the Origin of Maximilian formed 9 Planes and the route of a Nine Natures Extremity Foundation opened for him...
HOONG!
Wild waves of Extremity erupted around Noah's visage as notifications rose in waves.
[You have succeeded in doing the impossible!]
[Under the Influence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity, you overcame the reality of an Existence that reached their Absolute End.]
An existence that had reached their Absolute End!
One who could never even have the hope of achieving Extremity in their lifetime!
Noah reversed such a reality through nothing other than the Absolute Dynamis of Extremity
The thing considered an Absolute Seed of Extremity- the Indefatigable Dynamis!
[You have reversed an Absolute End and gone further to open up a new beginning that guarantees the targeted existence exceeding their prior accomplishments.
Your Convergence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity increases greatly.]
[Your achievements are being Recorded in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.]
[Your Authority as a Quintessential Aeonic Curator has Quintessentially risen.]
His achievements continued to climb as it became abundantly clear...this stage of combining concepts of Extremity held too much in store.
The abilities and potential alone held glorious hints of Extremity itself.
And all this...merely stemmed from a lesser than half formed Absolute Seed of Extremity.
What would Noah be capable of doing when this seed flourished?
What would happen when he actually achieved Extremity?!
The answer was disastrous enough to make his name feared across the Seven Aeonic Havens in the very near future!

chapters.title: Chapter 2426 A Deadly Scheme! I
paragraphs: [Your Authority as a Quintessential Aeonic Curator has Quintessentially risen.]
[Your Authority as a Quintessential Aeonic Curator...]
The prompt repeated a few times before Noah as the overabundance of cherry colored essence swirled around him.

The very essence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity moved from him and entrenched itself into Maximilian as he established the Nine Natures Extremity Foundation similar to the Emperor Penguin, the visage of Maximilian shaking as he radiated grandeur and power!

He seemed to emanate the majesty of an Emperor as his hair had changed to contain 9 streaks of colors matching his Nine Natures Extremity Foundation, his eyes now swirling with multicolored light as even with all this grandeur that he gave off...
His visage came to kneel on the vibrant space they were in as the tears in his eyes remained.
"You have done the unimaginable for me. Mere words cannot show my appreciation, but...I wholeheartedly give you all of my Aspects of Existence. Whatever your will is, I shall carry it out!"
WAA!

The tears in his eyes showed the unimaginable happiness at literally having the whole direction of his life flipped around, the gaze he looked towards Noah with being one that not even the Lernaean Apex Aeonic Lifeforms ever received!
Noah nodded towards Maximilian with a smile as he then looked around him once more.
The gazes of all beings here were expectant and excited as Noah looked towards them and the now quiet Soul Clones of Orion and Aurelia as he spoke grandly.
"In the bounds of Extremity, anything is possible."
The cherry essence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity coiled around him like an indomitable snake as he continued.

"In a short two days, the Lernaean Domains are on the way to be assimilated into the Infinite Plane as even this accomplishment...is a small one in the expanse of the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution, much less in all of Extremity"

"You all are about to receive an overhaul of your strength as I will reconstruct you into something even grander, so if you wish to give back...then bring to my feet the rest of the Domains within the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution."
WAA!

"Whether it is the domains of Noblesse, Quasarians, or Planeswalkers...so long as you can use your power to Conquer them under the banner of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor, you have done your part!"
Wild essence buzzed as while he spoke, the very concentration of energy in the surroundings changed with every breath.

The beings before him felt their blood surging as Katelyn, Eowyn, Henry, Kazuhiko, Barbatos...a great number of beings connected to him became even more firm in their resolve as they made promises to themselves.
"Strength is relative."

His figure floated above the beings here as stellar cherry tendrils of light formed beneath his feet like coiling rivers, the grandeur of Extremity they emanated making him feel like an ancient Emperor addressing his subjects!
"I may seem strong now, and you may look at those who have achieved the level of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms or even the prized Extremity as if they are immovable and unending...but even they die."

"So do not take these levels of power and attaining them to mean that we are invincible. There are unknown enemies out there butchering even those who have reached Extremity...so do not be complacent."

The Quintessential Kainos Emperor addressed his people as their Wills buzzed powerfully in response, his grand figure gazing towards them as he waved his hand to call forth an illusory blinding scroll of light.
"Now, as part of restructuring your strength...let me show you all how to breathe Quintessence."
WAA!

Intent on understanding as much as he could about the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity, Noah also pulled out the means of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity as alongside the goal of utilizing Realm Reconstruction on all prominent beings here- he would have them live and breathe Quintessence as he would Forge existences for surpassing even the Scions he was now facing in the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands!
Within the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution.

Two points of blinding light surged towards the region of the Ancestral Lernaeans that had coral colored points of light bloom- lights that made any other Dynamis of Extremity shudder as the vast majority of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms had to go towards it to see!
It meant that something profound had happened within the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution, or a particularly powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeforms had entered this Haven that they now had to be careful of.
Either way, they had to see.
But the moment these points of light crossed into the Lernaean Domains...
BZZZT!
A hazy veil of light simmering with Extremity rose as it came with a single message.
[Turn back.]
A message that caused the two lights comprising of two Noblesse Apex Aeonic Lifeforms to come to a halt!
After all, it carried with it the undeniable will of Extremity.
It didn't just appear before their eyes, but it appeared simultaneously before the figures of all Apex Aeonic Lifeforms that were seeking the origin of the oppressive Dynamis of Extremity!
"The hell? Why would something like this require the intervention of the Judge of Dissolution?"

A feminine voice filled with distaste and exasperation rang out as it was an exquisite humanoid figure of a Noblesse Apex Aeonic Lifeform with glowing obsidian skin that was covered by a tight black body suit that mapped out every glorious curvature of her figure. Dark hair draped past her shoulders to finish off her entire black attire as her beauty was utterly cosmic.
The man beside her gazed forward curiously at their advancement being stopped as he replied with caution.
"The Judge would only interfere when called upon to make an Oath, or if any fights arise with multiple Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, or if a lesser life form is involved against an Apex Aeonic Lifeform."

"Hmph, these were the changes of the birth of a Essence of Extremity with multiple concepts. What reason would there be for us to be stopped when we can even grasp something out of seeing its formation? For it to come from the Lernaean lands also concerns me..."
The female Noblesse Apex Aeonic Lifeform spat out her words as from her expression, one could sense great exasperation and callousness!

chapters.title: Chapter 2427 A Deadly Scheme! II
paragraphs: "...For it to come from the Lernaean lands also bothers me..."
Her last words were said with distaste as both she and the man beside her turned around to return to their domains.
Having received the command of someone that had reached Extremity, they of course wouldn't even dare of going against it!
The calculative man beside this exceedingly beautiful Noblesse replied while the void buzzed around him.
"Euryale...your frustration with the Lernaeans stems from their troops capturing over a dozen of our domains?"
"Hmph, fucking opportunistic rats is what they are," Euryale replied with sharp eyes as she continued.

"Our strongest contenders are sent to the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands for the purposes of Extremity Sanctification, and they use this time to send their forces to our weakened domains. What's even more distasteful is that somehow, the Eyes of that holier-than-thou Genesis seem to have shifted hands from our people and onto the commander leading the Lernaean forces."

As she spoke, her hands waved before them to reveal the image of a devilishly handsome young man with hair shining blue and black, his body surrounded by the light of wondrous Boundaries- this figure being none other than the Son of the True Emperor of Quintessence.

"And for them to be using multiple Consummate Boundaries, of course our unprepared troops would fall to them. It seems the Cult of Endless Shadows reached out to them far earlier and gave them the boons we're just now grasping from the Genesis Institute of Extremity."
The Cult of Endless Shadows had their influence fall on the Lernaeans as the Noblesse accepted the alliance with the Genesis Institute of Extremity!
The Planeswalkers had the Light of the Seven as their backing, and the Quasarians were likely to ally with the Singularity Overseers.
Euryale's dark pupils shone with malice as they returned to the Noblesse Domains, passing through the ones currently under occupation by Lernaeans as she spoke coldly.
"And for us to even be denied entry into Lernaean lands by the Extremity Adjudicator...its only just pushed me to carry out the plan I told you."
WAA!
Her words caused the man beside her to turn towards her with surprise as he shook his head while releasing calmer words out of the two.

"It may not be so wise, especially when Extremity Sanctification is just beginning in our Haven with multiple forces coming in. The Adjudicator is especially perceptive at a time like this to make sure that no regulations are being broken."

"My dear Brother Richard...what I plan to do will not break any regulations. But I do want it to send a very clear message to the Lernaeans for them to not overstep their Boundaries. I plan to simply attack a part of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform that is being used to unfairly dominate our Noblesse Reverends. Of course, the impact of attacks of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform can very easily carry over to the being holding the part of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform and those around him as these...will just be unintended casualties."
BOOM!
Her words were utterly deadly as she smiled with cruelty when she spoke!
She knew very well their position as for the past years, their forces were using the eyes of the Lernaean Apex Aeonic Lifeform they dug out for the purposes of treasure seeking.
They just didn't expect them to be taken back and fused into another Lernaean Lifeform seamlessly as at this point...she could act in a gray area!

She had immense frustrations from sitting back and dealing with the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from the Genesis Institute of Extremity coming in while they kept their prideful dispositions and distaste while talking to the Noblesse, and she had even more frustrations from seeing the domains of Noblesse be taken over one after another.
Being stopped by the Adjudicator from even entering Lernaean lands tipped her over the edge as something she had only thought of before...she wanted to put it into action now!
Yet beside her, Richard sighed while he rubbed his obsidian temples.

"Euryale...this whole thing just carries an unnecessary risk with very little rewards. All of those Lernaeans seem to be moving with clones as even if you reach their main bodies with your attack- the strongest commanders will likely have Apex Aeonic Lifeforms protecting their main bodies. Especially this boy that has the eyes of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform. And if you do manage to kill all of their Aspects of Existence entirely...you will then earn the disfavor of the Adjudicator of Dissolution for breaking regulations. At the very least, you may be forced to accept multiple Golden Haven Albatrosses or even an Obsidian Haven Albatross. At worst, you may be forced to take a Crimson Haven Albatross that even those who have reached Extremity can find peril with, if not being confined for a few million years."
His voice tried to be one of reason as there were too many things at stake.

Even the Culmination Step of the Extremity Vein of Dissolution may begin anytime within the next 100 years- and this would be a stage where Apex Aeonic Lifeforms can fight for opportunities to reach Extremity!
Why risk all this just for a single action?
Euryale smiled at such a thought as she turned towards Richard.
"You know me. Have I always been reasonable when it comes to my anger?"
The Apex Aeonic Lifeform opposite to her didn't reply as he instead looked past the Noblesse territories passing below them while sighing.

"And since I will be attacking the eyes of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform, I'll only get a slap on the wrist for the casualties around it. A Golden Haven Albatross or two at most...it doesn't really matter. But because of this, I want to ensure that my actions don't go to waste. I want to ensure that when I do make the move, it will be my strongest possible attack and that little rat leading the Lernaeans and those around him receive permanent demise without question. Let's see what the prophetic potential tells me..."
A dazzling verdant white light shone from her dark eyes as she focused on the illusory image of Henry before her.
An instant later, her brows rose as she smiled with brutality.

"You were right, if I were to attack now, the essence of the prophetic potential of Extremity tells me that the aura of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform is near him as they may be able to react to save his main body and a few others. I want their deaths to be certainties...so I will wait for the Prognostic Dynamis to tell me when the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms are furthest from the main bodies of these rats. Thereafter...ah, I relish thinking of their despair! Let's see if they dare to make a move for the Noblesse Domains then!"
WAA!
Brutal! Callous!
A deadly set of words erupted from her as Richard remained entirely silent!

chapters.title: Chapter 2428 I Love Making Enemies! I
paragraphs: Richard remained silent for a little while as he stared at the face of callousness and cruelty before he asked.
"And if the Lernaean Apex Aeonic Lifeforms come to seek retribution and seek war?"

"Haha, spark an Apex War over a lesser lifeform? Doubtful. But even if they do, then what? You know how much Apex Aeonic Lifeforms are valued. Before we kill too many of them, the Adjudicator of Dissolution would likely intervene and stop the conflict. We may have one or two casualties on our side as to erase the power of one of the Lineages vying for hegemony here...it's a worthy enough cost. I don't much care if the casualties are Irena and Gakus who were acting like the dogs of the Genesis Institute of Extremity already to get in their good shoes."
An Apex War!

Apex Aeonic Lifeforms represented a grand power across the Havens as they were treasured, with fights to the death frowned upon as the goal was to grow as many Apex Aeonic Lifeforms across the Seven Aeonic Havens.
But there were times when irreconcilable differences occurred, and a certain War could be waged.
A War between two sides where the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms fought for supremacy.
An Apex War!
The radiant obsidian skin of Euryale and Richard shone brightly as each one had their own thoughts.
The latter thought of the consequences of all this while the former...
The Essence of the Prognostic Dynamis of Extremity shone brightly in her eyes as she waited.

She waited for the most opportune time to make a move and strike at the eyes of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform attached to a lesser lifeform...eradicating this being's Clone and the main body wherever it was hidden!
Her Dynamis of Extremity would ensure so!
Her eyes held a vile and twisted sense of power as even after living for millions or billions of years, the base nature of some beings never changed.
If cruelty and unreasonableness were ingrained in their minds, they wouldn't so easily fade away in time.
And so, an utterly unreasonable Apex Aeonic Lifeform set her eyes on the visage of Henry Osmont and the Vassals following him as the fallout to come from the actions she wanted to commit was unknown!
Within the depths of the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands.

Colossal obelisks floated in the vibrant space as titanic Leviathans of Dissolution stood imposingly above them- every single one lying in front of the path leading towards the Crimson Extremity Panacea blooming in the distance!

Scions of extremely powerful Inheritances moved around with intent and purpose as among the most powerful, their bodies buzzed with unique circulation methods as Boundary Essences surged around them with purpose and glory!

The visage of the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity remained stellar as his cosmic purple blue humanoid form gained a hint of coral colored grandeur, the essence of Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity seemingly adding its color to his stellar humanoid form as he stared towards the laid back figure of Erikson.
Of the Scion stemming from the Sima Clan who just extended an invitation!
So he replied calmly and with grandiosity.
"I don't know much about the Sima Clan to decide whether it is worthy of having someone like me."
Words that drew sharp breaths for those spreading their Wills here to listen!
These words even caused the Scions adorned in suits behind Master Erikson to squint their eyes sharply while Erikson himself...smiled and laughed boisterously.

"Haha, with guts to say things like that, you're fit to join the Sima Clan. Since you didn't give me a straight answer, I'll assume you aren't thinking of joining factions right now or you're holding back since you aren't yet aware of what it truly means to join a Hegemony like the Sima Clan. How about we have a friendly competition for the First Extremity Panacea over there? I'll get to show you what SIMA means as whether I win it or you win it, you can make your decision then."
WAA!
His words were those of grandeur and confidence.
Even after seeing the light radiating from Noah's body that explicitly showed a high tier Dynamis of Extremity, Erikson was actually not fearful as he proposed a amicable competition!
The eyes consisted of spinning Infinite singularities within Noah's blank face twisted into a devilish smile as he replied.
"I don't normally have amicable competitions. Anyone I compete with for anything normally ends up devoured by me to lay the stones of my foundation."
When he fought or competed against others, it was mainly enemies who in the end would grant Loot!
"Well..." Yet towards his words, Erikson pointed freely in the distance as he also smiled calmly.
"...I'm sure those guys in the distance will be enough for you to devour and remain happy for now. What will it be?"

A Scion of the Sima Clan extended a proposal as after the curiosity of the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity was piqued, he waved his hand while nodding and reading the waves of Providence and Destiny!
"Then let me see the caliber of Scions who sit above normal Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity."
"Mmm, good. Let's go!"

The Scions adorned in suits behind him faded and moved out of the way as the astounding countenance of Erikson shot out like a bullet, a blinding light shining from Noah's Reified Source of Quintessence as he also disappeared!
Around this same time, the voice of Ayame rang out across this space.
"You two seem to think you're the only powerful ones here..."
BZZZT!
Her figure also shot out like a blazing sun as from multiple other directions, potent auras far exceeding the norms of Reverend Emperors appeared one after another to prove themselves!
In the distance, the words uttered by Noah and Erikson were picked up on by Phos and the few hundred Scions surrounding Noah's 8 other Reified Sources of Extremity.

Phos's expression was unpleasant as the runic magic circle below his feet radiated even deadlier light as his voice echoed out towards Noah's different forms that had begun to be wrapped with an incandescent coral colored light.

"You're obviously someone with status belongings to an Aeonic Inheritance of Extremity, are you sure you should be making enemies with this many Scions of multiple Inheritances? Can you manage the stress that shall be pressing down on you and your people?!"

"And if the Lernaean Apex Aeonic Lifeforms come to seek retribution and seek war?"
"Haha, spark an Apex War over a lesser lifeform?
Doubtful.
But even if they do, then what?
