chapters.title: Chapter 2429 I Love Making Enemies! II
paragraphs: "... Can you handle the pressure that shall be pressing down on you and your people?!"
Phos questioned whether this being truly wanted an all out war when they could all be focusing on procuring Extremity Panaceas!
Yet the form of Noah sitting on an Apocalyptic war horse stepped forward and spoke with a cold smile.
"I love making enemies."
WAA
It was the Harbinger of Entropy- Bellicus!

He carried the devilish looks of Noah's main body along with swirling waves of Entropy as he continued, the reified forms of the Arcane Haven Source Engine, The Apocalyptic Haven Dragon of Ruin, The Nullified Phoenix of Cataclysm, The Dreamer of Extremity, The Aeonic Demon Emperor of Destruction, The Aeonic Cache Bringer, and The Vampyre of Extreme Sanguinity all stood beside him with glorious waves of power- each one expressing Noah's soul and will through their own extremes!
"I love making enemies so much that I even treat my enemies better than my friends, after all...my enemies are kind enough to give me loot!"
His demeanor was imposing as he didn't take a step back, those facing him realizing this fully as Phos' expression hardened.
He was Phos of the Extremity of Light from the Aeonic Haven of Helios.
Magic circles constantly rotated around his body, his hair shining with a stellar white and blue luster as he was someone of great standing!
For his own pride and to stand for the honor of the name of Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity, he had chosen to stand against this being and teach him a lesson.
But this was before learning that this being was one that had already managed to step on the path of forming a Dynamis of Extremity with multiple concepts within it!
The pressure he felt from the essence that seemed to go from a light crimson to coral to cherry red felt the same as what a select few Apex Aeonic Lifeforms in his Extremity of Light gave off.
Since he was a being with such an identity, Phos had tried to back off just now!
But this being was unreasonable. Even when others gave him a step back, he didn't do the same as he barreled towards conflict with a hundred more steps.
So he voiced out to those he had garnered the support of around him.
"Extremity Panaceas have begun to bloom as this fiend lies before us to purposefully stop our advancement. Go all out and let's wrap this up quickly!"
WAA!

In the surroundings, dozens of Sources of light glimmered as the bodies of the Scions stemming from Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity buzzed with grandeur, each one using their own unique Circulation Modus Operandi to churn their Boundaries across their bodies and achieve a terrific effect of power!

Phos and the other Scions from the Extremity of Light did the same as their bodies became covered by a hazy cerulean gold light, each of them achieving a state of [Superluminal] speed as facing off against any other Scions, they were a force to fear.

Yet the 8 Reified Sources of Extremity before them also erupted at this moment as the Vampyre of Extreme Sanguinity that represented the Boundary of Blood stepped forth beside Bellicus, his image being that of an existence that all Vampyres revere and tremble as his mere presence as silver hair dripped past his shoulders!

An illusory endless sea of blood could be seen in his eyes and stretched out behind him as he seemed like a more refined and slender visage of Noah, his silver strands of hair that seemed like silver rivers of reality vibrating as he spoke with a devilish smile.
"You call that the circulation of Boundaries?"
A question that caused an awe inspiring foreboding sense to descend.
As the Scions of various Inheritances circulated their Boundary Essences, Noah gazed at them with cold disdain as he spoke out grandly.
"This...is the circulation of Boundaries!"
THUMP!
His devilishly handsome face exhaled in as all those here felt like they heard the beating of an ancient drum.
His chest then expanded as he...breathed in. And the moment he did so, everything went haywire!
BZZZT!

Torrential waves of essence in the surroundings were seemingly pulled towards the Reified Sources of Blood as he wasn't alone, all 8 of Noah's Reified Sources here breathing in Quintessentially as it seemed all concepts of Extremity were flowing towards them.

Even the circulating essence within the bodies of the Scions was disrupted and brought to a halt as their methods of circulation were affected and superseded, a decent number of skins turning red and spitting out crimson gold blood from the mere aftershock of his breath!
Of Noah simply breathing!

His 8 Reified bodies then released incandescent glows as even if one took the strength of the aura of a Dynamis of Extremity swirling around him, the way his body hummed from the circulation of more than a dozen Boundaries released a pressure multiple levels more than any of the Scions surrounding him.
A heavy silence briefly descended before soon after...
"Oh, fuck this."
Those in the periphery of forces surrounding Noah had their senses buzz as some retracted standing up for the name of Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity and began pulling back.

Many beings here had their pride and arrogance as they would stand for the name of their Inheritances, but when seeing the mere breathing of the Entity they surrounded throw the whole surroundings into chaos and even suppress their own circulation methods?
Some instantly knew to take a step back!
Yet at such a juncture...
"Now is no time to regret the choices already made."

The figure of the Dreamer of Extremity- Noah's Reified Source of Dreams uttered out grandly as he was decorated in sandy gold robes- an immaculate reality of Dreams forming around him as to his left, The Reified Sources of Ruin- The Apocalyptic Haven Dragon of Ruin, spoke next while releasing a cherry colored light that was mixed with an immense shadow of darkness.
"Now is the time for you all to hold on tightly to your destiny... and make sure that it is not brought to an untimely end."
[Aeonic Anti-Mana].
HOOONG!
A hint of crimson.
A hint of white.
A hint of blue.
A hint of immense darkness...all mixed in and burst outwards into a realm that covered all the enemies near Noah!
Anti-Mana.
What Noah would've been able to utilize fully at 100% Convergence of the First Unnamed Dynamis of Extremity.
What attained before even a quarter of the Convergence of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity was completed!
What exactly did it entail?
A glimpse of a single sentence within its description predicted the terrors to come.
[Aeonic Anti-Mana]...The complete deniability of the workings of Reality...
